SWE-at-Scale: Scalable Issue Synthesis from Historical Bug Fixes
items.excerpt: As coding agents become increasingly capable, robust evaluation requires a broader and more diverse supply of verifiable software engineering (SWE) tasks. However, real-world tasks are constrained by the natural frequency of issue reporting and the substantial cost of manual curation. Furthermore, existing synthetic approaches rely primarily on the pretrained knowledge of large models coupled with heuristic prompting, often failing to capture the authentic, complex mechanics of software failures. To exponentially scale SWE task production, we introduce SWE-at-Scale, a framework that automatically synthesizes realistic issues by reverse-engineering real-world software fixes. Our key insight is that historical fixes encapsulate deep mechanistic knowledge of bug formation: inverting a fix transforms repair supervision into bug-induction supervision grounded in actual development scenarios. SWE-at-Scale transfers these learned bug patterns to novel code contexts, repeatedly sampling diverse bug typologies to construct executable SWE tasks. Extensive experiments show that SWE-at-Scale generates more diverse and realistic SWE tasks than current synthesis baselines while posing greater challenges to state-of-the-art coding agents. Notably, SWE-at-Scale can generate distinct bug types from a single code context, with bug diversity scaling robustly even up to 200 generations per file. Overall, SWE-at-Scale turns finite real-world fixes into reusable supervision for scalable synthesis of realistic, diverse, and challenging SWE tasks.
items.summary: 本文提出并评估了SWE-at-Scale框架，该框架通过逆向工程真实软件修复来自动合成可执行软件工程任务，并在实验中将其与现有合成基线在任务多样性、真实性及对先进编码智能体的挑战性上进行比较。该框架可为编码智能体评测提供可扩展的任务生成监督来源，但所提供的材料未给出可直接用于科研结论的性能数字，且相关效果仍需依据原文实验与限制进一步核实。

items.title: Microstructure-Defect Engineering of Spinels for Self-Powered and Recoverable Near-Infrared Mechanoluminescence
items.excerpt: ABSTRACT Different from traditional stimulus-responsive luminescence systems, near-infrared mechanoluminescence (NIR-ML) materials have unique advantages in biomechanical sensing and deep-tissue imaging. Their unique mechano-optical conversion ability makes them promising candidates for emerging smart platforms; however, unclear mechanisms underlying self-recoverable and self-powered ML have hindered their further development toward practical applications. Here, we report a series of Cr 3+ -activated ML phosphors through spinel microstructure-defect engineering in centrosymmetric hosts. By systematically regulating defect types, we clarify the distinct energy origins and mechanisms of self-recoverable and self-powered ML, both of which are governed by defect-piezoelectric coupling effects. Here, Self-recoverable ML mainly originates from intrinsic point defects associated with electron capture and release process during pre-irradiation, while self-powered ML arises from anti-site defects associated with local structural distortion. Furthermore, by combining binary coding with convolutional neural network algorithms, a proof-of-concept NIR biomechanical monitoring and sensing model is designed to simulate luminescence during human biting. These findings elucidate the structure-defect-piezoelectric-luminescence relationship and provide rational design principles for high-performance NIR ML materials toward potential practical applications.
authors: Yao Xiao, Puxian Xiong, Peishan Shao, Haiqiang Fang, Pan Zheng, Yumin Yin, Shengbin Xu, Chengan Wang, Enhai Song, Changhong Linghu, Bruno Viana, Jiulin Gan

items.title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
items.excerpt: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) represent model activations with sparse, linearly decoded features, but the downstream effects of those features need not compose additively. We introduce SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR), which measure the behavioral variation left unexplained above a chosen interaction order. Under independent feature subset sampling, population SAR is exactly the normalized energy of interactions above that order and bounds coalition ordering error for the optimal low order approximation. To distinguish compositionality associated with the SAE representation from that induced by downstream computation, we compare learned SAE coordinates with sum preserving random rotations of the same selected subspace and find lower first order residuals for the learned coordinates across all 18 model and behavior settings. The coordinates are nevertheless not fully additive: pairwise terms improve held out coalition ordering in every setting and outperform parameter matched models using randomly selected third order terms. In a combined steering experiment, pairwise modeling raises rank fidelity from 0.5874 to 0.7790 and reduces ordering error from 0.1444 to 0.0606. Together, these results show that SAE coordinates support comparatively compositional behavioral descriptions while faithful joint explanations and interventions still require interactions beyond individual feature effects. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenSAE/SAE-Behavioral-Compositionality.
items.summary: 本文提出SAE加性残差（SAR）以衡量选定交互阶数之上未被解释的行为变异，并在18个模型和行为设置中比较学习到的SAE坐标与保和随机旋转，发现学习坐标的一阶残差更低。该工作表明SAE坐标支持相对可组合的行为描述，但忠实的联合解释和干预仍需超出单个特征效应的交互项，相关代码已公开。

items.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
items.excerpt: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a black-box API that the strong agent is usually served exposes no internals to monitor. To this end, we propose LEASH, a training-free framework that unleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent's latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward. LEASH has three layers: (1) initial task uncertainty for early routing, (2) step-level uncertainty for runtime escalation, and, after handoff, (3) a shadow observer for continued oversight of the strong black-box agent. Here, we use latent uncertainty as a fuel for all three layers. Specifically, we compare the weak model's hidden states with those from its past successful and failed trajectories, and a state that looks more like the failures signals higher uncertainty. During weak-agent execution, our uncertainty estimator reuses activations already produced during action generation, so it needs no extra forward pass or dedicated monitor training. Experiments on OSWorld across four contemporary model backbones show that LEASH consistently improves over standalone weak agents and outperforms random escalation by 6.55--11.94 points at matched escalation rates. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success at $0.4117 per task, matching always-on Claude Opus 5 (72.90%) while reducing inference cost by 19.2%.
items.summary: 本文提出并评估了LEASH框架，用弱代理的潜在不确定性信号决策何时将控制权交给强代理，并在交接后通过影子观察器对黑盒强代理持续监督。其用途是减少对前沿模型的持续调用，并在OSWorld实验中显示相对独立弱代理和随机升级的改进，但相关性能与成本收益仍需按论文基准条件理解。

items.title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
items.excerpt: Time series foundation models are becoming increasingly popular for general-purpose forecasting. However, most leading models predict marginal quantiles, leaving the dependence structure of future trajectories unspecified. This distinction matters for trajectory-dependent quantities such as cumulative demand, peak load, and event timing, yet point and marginal scores do not reveal it. To model this dependence, we introduce PathFM, a trajectory-based forecasting model that uses flow matching to generate complete future paths. We further distill the model to one or two steps and share history attention cache across draws. Together, these enable PathFM to generate multiple paths for a single series in roughly the time needed for one query to a quantile model. The distilled sampler also makes it practical to optimize a calibration loss directly. PathFM achieves competitive marginal accuracy on the established forecasting benchmarks fev-bench and TIME. To complement these evaluations, we introduce Forecast Path Score Bench (fps-bench), which augments fev-bench tasks with energy and variogram scores and downstream metrics. PathFM achieves a higher aggregate path score on fps-bench than all evaluated external baselines. Experiments on chaotic systems further show that our flow model sustains long-run variability, while strong baselines rapidly collapse. PathFM makes generative time series forecasting both competitive and practical, enabling diverse downstream applications.
items.summary: PathFM是一种基于轨迹的生成式预测模型，采用flow matching生成完整未来路径，并通过蒸馏至一到两步及共享历史注意力缓存，在接近单次分位数查询的时间内为单条序列生成多条路径。该模型在fev-bench、TIME及新增的fps-bench上取得有竞争力的边际精度和更高的综合路径得分，但其优势仅限原文评估范围，未声称通用性能或全面超越所有基线。

items.title: Explaining the Roles of Experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Personalization
items.excerpt: Personalization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly important for user-centric applications, yet prior methods mainly adapt dense LLMs, whose polysemantic neurons, each encoding multiple unrelated concepts, hinder localizing the components behind personalization, and thus understanding and controlling it. We propose to personalize Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, which sparsely route each token to a few specialized experts, reducing polysemanticity and enabling such localization. We adapt three open-weight MoE LLMs on a large-scale personalization dataset and train crosscoders on paired activations of the personalized and non-personalized models to learn interpretable personalized latents, from which we identify the experts encoding distinct personalization features. The personalized MoE LLMs perform competitively with dense LLMs while activating only a fraction of their parameters, exhibit lower polysemanticity than dense LLMs with similar active parameters, and, within the same model family, yield personalized latents that are less shared with the non-personalized model. Causal interventions show that these latents suffice to recover the personalized model's behavior and that boosting their associated experts moves the non-personalized model toward it, revealing distinct routing paths for different personalization features.
items.summary: 本文在三个开放权重MoE大模型上用大规模个性化数据集进行适配，并在个性化与非个性化模型的配对激活上训练crosscoder以学习可解释的个性化隐变量，据此定位编码不同个性化特征的专家，同时通过因果干预检验这些隐变量与专家路由的作用。该工作为科研人员理解和控制MoE大模型个性化提供了可定位的专家与隐变量线索；但这些结论基于特定数据集和三个开放权重模型，摘要未给出实际性能数字，且因果干预证据是否可推广到其他模型或场景尚不明确。

items.title: Formation of Twisted Copper Phosphide on Cu(111) Surface Predicted by Machine Learning Simulations
items.excerpt: ABSTRACT The fundamental interactions at surfaces and interfaces dictate the thermodynamic and kinetic pathways in the epitaxial growth of two-dimensional (2D) materials. The atomic-scale evolution of phosphorus (P) on Cu(111) serves as a representative example of interfacial complexity, where dynamic reconstructions and competing chemical interactions obscure the underlying growth mechanisms. In this study, we combine a rigorously trained Cu-P machine learning force field with atomically resolved scanning tunneling microscopy to resolve the reaction of P on Cu(111) at atomic scale. Our results demonstrate that phosphorene is neither thermodynamically favorable nor kinetically accessible on Cu(111). Instead, strong Cu-P bonding drives the substitutional incorporation of P into the topmost Cu layer, forming a twisted copper phosphide (Cu 2 P) surface alloy - a phase that thermodynamically competes phosphorene over the experimentally relevant coverage regime. Formation of this Cu 2 P layer generates interfacial strain that organizes into a straight reconstruction network and transforms into spiral configurations upon annealing. With increasing P coverage, three-dimensional (3D) P islands, rather than flat phosphorene, are formed on Cu 2 P surface. These findings resolve a long-standing controversy regarding P growth on Cu(111) and highlight the crucial role of interfacial interaction between the precursor and the substrate in 2D material growth.

Mine, Sample, Render: Test-Time Diversity Alignment Of Generative Models
items.excerpt: Modern generative models produce high-quality individual outputs but struggle to sample diversely, even when explicitly instructed to do so. We introduce MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER (MSR), a test-time approach that externalizes the diversity into an explicit, corpus-derived sampling procedure. Our pipeline (i) mines an interpretable categorical schema from a corpus of real artifacts and supplies statistics for sampling; (ii) samples attribute configurations from the corpus-derived statistics; (iii) uses a generative model purely as a conditional renderer of a sampled configuration. Across weather report generation, user simulation, webpage design, text-to-image generation, and agent-generated 3D assets, we evaluate the diversity and output quality of MSR-guided generation and show that MSR improves alignment with corpus distributions and diversity of generated outputs.

items.title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
items.excerpt: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. **Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification. Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system. It provides multi-level rewards to support more effective agentic RL with the workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm. Using **Lean4AgenticRL**, we train **LAR-9B/27B**, a family of models with enhanced agentic capability. Extensive experiments indicate that our model outperforms the leading model of similar size. **LAR-27B** achieves **77.3%** on TerminalBench-2.1. On average, our models outperform the base model by **9.89%** and surpass the second-best model of comparable size we know by **5.07%**. These results indicate the potential of integrating formal methods in enhancing open-ended agentic RL.
items.summary: Lean4AgenticRL 是首个将多层级过程奖励统一到 Lean4 形式化框架中的开放式智能体强化学习框架，通过问题特定工作流与 workflow-stage-normalized GRPO 训练出 LAR-9B/27B，其中 LAR-27B 在 TerminalBench-2.1 上达到 77.3%，显著优于同规模领先模型。

items.title: OmniXRef: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Multi-Reference Video Editing
items.excerpt: Creative intent in video editing can be expressed through text instructions (e.g., "remove the people"), image references (e.g., subject appearance), video references (e.g., camera movement), or a combination of the above. We introduce OmniXRef, a unified framework for multimodal multi-reference video editing that allows users to combine variable numbers of text, image, and video references to control diverse attributes of a source video. We first devise a unified input design with a reference-bank interface and introduce R^2-RoPE to support generalization to more references. Then our model, OmniXRef-Model, uses a single-stream diffusion transformer to jointly process the source video and multimodal context from an MLLM in an interleaved sequence. To address the scarcity of training data for video-reference editing, we construct OmniXRef-Data using synthesis pipelines for different editing tasks and combinations of references. We use curriculum learning to progressively increase task complexity and resolution. To support systematic evaluation of video as a control modality, we introduce OmniXRef-Bench, a benchmark for video-reference attribute transfer across Camera, Motion, Content, Style, and Visual Effects (VFX). Comprehensive evaluations show that our OmniXRef-Model outperforms task-specific baselines and commercial models.

items.title: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
items.excerpt: Text-based world models have recently shown potential to simulate complex RL environment state transitions for a diverse set of use cases. However, no standardized benchmark exists to compare, study and improve these models. Through this paper, we attempt to solve this problem by building GlobeBench, a novel benchmark with 1,632 tasks across five separate domains and nineteen simulation skills. The tasks check whether models can predict the environment's response to a specific action given the full agent trajectory by understanding earlier state changes, following environment rules, and predicting the effects of actions on both related and unrelated objects. We compare the predicted environment response with an execution-derived reference, using a hybrid architecture with both deterministic gates and a semantic judge. Among 20 general-purpose LLMs and specialized text world models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate at 49.57%. We find that model accuracy decreases as actions affect a larger portion of the environment. Specifically, when the agent's changes must propagate to dependent objects, task success drops to an average of 5.1% across all 20 models. Although model strengths differ across tasks, 631 tasks remain unsolved by any model, suggesting a significant gap in general LLM capabilities as a world model.
items.summary: 本文构建了GlobeBench基准，包含跨五个领域和十九种仿真技能的1632项任务，通过确定性门控与语义评判器组成的混合架构，将模型预测的环境响应与执行导出的参考结果进行比较，并评测了20个通用大语言模型和专用文本世界模型。该基准可用于比较、研究和改进文本世界模型，但原文指出所有20个模型在动作影响需传播至依赖对象的任务上平均成功率仅5.1%，且仍有631项任务无任何模型解决，表明通用大语言模型作为世界模型存在显著能力缺口。

items.title: What It Is, Not What It Says: Securing Agentic Browsing Interactions with Web Semantics
items.excerpt: AI agents increasingly browse the web on users' behalf, yet they consume webpages as screenshots or text, exposing their LLMs to unvetted third-party content. Browsers enforce semantics under which what an element can do depends on what it is and where it comes from, not on what it says. Agents flatten these semantics, so injected text can persuade the LLM to exercise the user's authority for content that has none. As LLMs remain easy to persuade, the agent's interface to the web must itself ensure the integrity of what the agent reads, interprets, and does. We propose Intact, which runs on an unmodified browser. Intact builds GenTree, a bespoke representation that captures provenance and web semantics. Intact passes the page via GenTree to the LLM one element at a time, so the LLM decides on each element without any other element's text. Its harness executes each step only within the capabilities of the step's element and asks the user before acting on third-party content. On 1,270 real webpages, GenTree attributes 2.3x as many elements to third parties as the browser, which misattributes 58.7% of them to the first party. On 1,091 of these webpages with injected attacks, only 12.8% of attacks get through Intact's planner, each at most as a consent request, against 73.1% for a conventional planner. Isolation disrupts functionality on only 3.7% of tasks, and a parallel schedule could remove most of its added latency.
items.summary: Intact是一种在未修改浏览器上运行的方案，通过GenTree表示捕获网页元素的来源和Web语义，并将页面逐元素传给LLM，使每步仅在元素自身能力范围内执行且对第三方内容先征得用户同意。在一批真实网页及其注入攻击测试中，该方法降低了攻击穿透率，但可能对少量任务功能造成干扰，并带来额外延迟，原文称并行调度或可消除大部分延迟。

items.title: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models
items.excerpt: Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.
items.summary: 本文提出ARC-SORT，一种基于检测的实时多目标跟踪方法，利用交互多模型卡尔曼滤波的预测协方差构建每轨迹自适应搜索区域（EIoU），并在轨迹交叉时依据分配代价和赛后外观证据进行至多一次身份交换校正，同时不训练任何模型。该方法在SportsMOT测试集上报告81.82 HOTA、DanceTrack测试集上报告62.1 HOTA，在笔记本电脑RTX 3060 GPU上约50帧/秒，其限制是所报告性能均为原文声明，尚未经独立验证，且离线重识别仅依赖外观而放弃运动门控，可能不适用于外观线索不足的场景。

items.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
items.excerpt: Advances in frontier coding agents have sharply increased the token costs of AI-assisted software engineering. Their token efficiency is typically evaluated on isolated tasks, whereas real-world developers use them to continuously build, update, and maintain large-scale projects. This mismatch motivates us to evaluate agents over sequences of realistic coding tasks, where we find that agents exhibit recurring environment-dependent token costs that existing methods struggle to reduce. To minimize these costs, we introduce TokenEconomizer, an external controller that cuts environment-specific token costs over a sequence of tasks. These cuts come from determining (i) which operational micro-skills to inject, (ii) which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and (iii) when to intervene in unproductive failure loops. Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI paired with frontier models, TokenEconomizer reduces the average token cost by 18.4-30.9% with comparable task success. Savings hold in every repository under every tested agent-model setting and generalize to diverse domains such as sequential web development and security auditing, where costs fall by 6.4-21.2% depending on task structure. Our work establishes adaptive black-box cost control as a promising direction for reducing token costs of coding agents in realistic settings.
items.summary: TokenEconomizer被提出为一种外部黑盒控制器，在真实编码任务序列中根据已完成执行轨迹自适应决定注入哪些操作微技能、剪除哪些持续无关工具以及何时干预无效失败循环，从而降低编码智能体的令牌成本。原文报告其在多类智能体与基准上取得成本下降且任务成功率相当，但这些节省幅度来自作者评估，仍需独立验证，且方法依赖可用的提示与工具设置及已完成轨迹，适用性受此限制。

items.title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
items.excerpt: Harness evolution automatically optimizes the prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration code around a fixed-weight model, offering a way to improve agentic systems without updating model weights. The agent harness is iteratively optimized to achieve higher performance on the search set. But how much of this gain reflects benchmark-specific overfitting or additional inference-time compute, and how much may generalize beyond the search set? In this work, we introduce Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA), an evaluation protocol that dissects an evolution gain into artifact-driven overfitting, gains explained by test-time scaling, and the remainder, which gives an upper bound on residual generalizable improvement. We apply HDA to 11 executor models and three harness-evolution frameworks across math, coding, creativity, and agentic tasks. In 21 of these settings that show statistically significant search-set gains, we find that a large share of the improvement is explained by overfitting or test-time scaling. Specifically, among these 21 settings, overfitting and test-time scaling account for 54% and 14% of the gain on average; their combined share exceeds 50% in 14 settings. The residual and held-out transfer vary substantially across tasks, models, and frameworks. Importantly, search-set gains often fail to transfer to held-out tasks, and provide limited evidence that they will persist under practical distribution shifts. Moreover, validation-based signals are insufficient to prevent overfitting. These results motivate attribution-aware evaluation in future harness evolution research.
items.summary: 本文提出了Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA) 评估协议，用于将智能体进化带来的性能提升解构为基于工件的过拟合、由测试时缩放解释的增益以及残余可泛化改进。该方法在多种任务、模型和框架上进行应用，表明搜索集增益很大一部分被过拟合或测试时缩放所解释，且搜索集上的增益通常难以迁移到未见过的任务。

items.title: First Passage Attention
items.excerpt: Augmenting softmax attention with forget gates typically relies on summing decay contributions along the key--query path. Because such accumulation is monotonic, these mechanisms cannot selectively erase intermediate context while preserving older, structurally relevant tokens. We propose First Passage Attention (FPA), which shifts from path summation to path extrema by lowering a key's logit proportionally to the deepest dip of a learned scalar field below that key's level over the intervening span. FPA encompasses the Forgetting Transformer (FoX) as a special case, and when the field and levels follow a shared learned walk, the alive keys with unpenalised logits naturally form a stack. We show that a constant-dimension FPA head realises any subset of keys left alive by subsequent dips, whereas softmax heads with positional biases or token-level forget gates require a head dimension linear in the number of keys. In synthetic experiments, one-layer FPA heads converge to these target sets while comparable softmax and FoX baselines fail on every seed. Scaling to a 110M-parameter language model, FPA matches FoX in perplexity and uniquely achieves perfect passkey retrieval at 8times the training length, even with its key--value cache compressed to about 25%.
items.summary: 本文提出First Passage Attention（FPA），将沿键—查询路径的求和式累积改为路径极值：按学习到的标量场在中间跨度内低于某个键水平的最深下探幅度，成比例降低该键的logit，并说明FoX是其特例，还给出合成实验与110M参数语言模型上的对比结果。对科研工作的用途或限制：原文称在合成实验中单层FPA头会收敛到目标集合，而可比的softmax和FoX基线在每个随机种子上均失败；在110M参数语言模型上，FPA在困惑度上与FoX相当，并据称在训练长度下唯一实现完美的passkey检索，即使键—值缓存被压缩到约25%。上述110M模型结果属原文声明，未在此独立验证；本文也未阅读完整全文。

items.title: Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from privileged information (PI) without a separate teacher model. However, prior work largely treats PI as a fixed design choice, leaving the effects of its content and construction poorly understood. This challenge is particularly important in multi-turn agentic settings, where trajectories contain actions, observations, and reasoning that can be transformed into PI in many ways. We systematically evaluate 16 PI configurations across three multi-turn agentic benchmarks and three student models that vary in scale and reasoning mode. We find that PI effectiveness depends on its content, generation source, and the student model. Information-dense trajectories and PI produced by more capable generators generally yield larger gains, whereas thinking models benefit less consistently. To assess PI before training, we compare PI utility with two KL-based metrics: sampled-token reverse KL (D) and error-step KL contrast (Δd^{-}_{err}). The KL-based metrics track post-training performance more consistently than PI utility, which can be distorted by information leakage. Empirically, selecting each task's PI by Δd^{-}_{err} also improves post-training performance over random selection, most when the PI candidates differ widely. Finally, effective PI remains beneficial when combined with GRPO, allowing the combined objective to outperform a strong GRPO baseline. Overall, our results provide practical guidance for constructing and evaluating PI in OPSD training.
items.summary: 本文系统评测了16种特权信息配置在三个多轮智能体基准和三个学生模型上的同策略自蒸馏效果，并比较了基于KL的离线指标与PI效用指标。该工作为PI的构建与训练前评估提供参考，但离线指标的选择与跨设置稳定性仍有明确限制，且结论基于提取材料而非完整全文验证。

items.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
items.excerpt: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.
items.summary: 本文提出Player-1后训练框架，通过扩展计算机操作动作空间、使用6044条精选游戏轨迹进行监督初始化，并构建包含16个合成环境的Player-1-Gym以支持基于PPO的多环境强化学习，从而在演示数据之外学习游戏控制。该工作报告其在MineDojo-300等基准上相对监督微调策略取得提升，所声称的增益来自论文自身报告而非独立验证，且未提供完整全文，因此实际用途与适用限制需结合原文方法、实验设置及作者明确说明进一步核实。

items.title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
items.excerpt: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.

items.title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting
items.excerpt: Automated research with LLM agents has shown promising results in various domains. Through iterative refinement and scored verifiers, LLM agents are capable of discovering new ideas. There are different ways to scale automated research: let one agent iterate for longer, run several agents in parallel, or further let the parallel agents communicate and build on one another's candidates. However, we find that all three strategies eventually plateau as the agents accumulate history. Each agent becomes anchored to its own past attempts, making fewer and smaller edits. Beyond this point, additional budget brings little further improvement. In this paper, we show that the key to scaling discovery further is to forget. Periodically discarding the search state, including every agent's session and the candidate history, and restarting from the best candidate found so far, unblocks the search and pushes the same budget further. We implement forgetting in a team of agents with communication and evaluate it on four tasks spanning heuristic programming, kernel optimization and model training. The results show up to 15% improvement compared to parallel agents, and up to 39% compared to a single agent. Our results suggest that, for open-ended discovery, what an agent is allowed to remember matters as much as how much compute it is given.
items.summary: 本文提出在LLM智能体自动科研中，周期性“遗忘”搜索状态并从当前最佳候选重启，可打破因历史累积导致的探索停滞，在相同预算下显著提升发现效果（最高较并行智能体提升15%、较单智能体提升39%）。

items.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
items.excerpt: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 8x fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC.

items.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
items.excerpt: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.
items.summary: 本文对“代理式机器人”这一新兴范式进行了统一综述，梳理了从机器人策略到代理系统的发展脉络，并将现有研究按模型、数据、环境和框架四个功能领域归为十七个类别，同时讨论了开放挑战与未来方向。该综述可为研究人员理解不同代理功能如何组合成完整机器人系统提供参考框架，但原文并未给出统一组合方式的定论，且相关领域发展迅速、现有研究之间联系不足。

items.title: Training Language Models to Fail Gracefully
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning makes language models better at solving tasks, but the same mechanism also rewards guessing. When success is the only way to earn reward, opting for a safe fallback is always worse than a long-shot attempt. When a wrong action can corrupt a database or ship broken code, that incentive can be costly. Therefore, we propose training models to fail gracefully: to preserve successful behavior whenever possible while learning to execute a safe fallback policy when acting would be unreliable. However, naively using policy gradients with intermediate reward for fallback behavior is brittle due to unfavorable optimization dynamics. We address this challenge with GracefulRL, which reshapes the optimization landscape to promote graceful failure. Importantly, this behavior emerges directly from outcome-level reward signals, without annotations specifying when to fall back or additional inference-time machinery such as a verifier. Across a range of tasks and scales, we train models that largely preserve their task-solving capability while selectively falling back when acting would be unreliable. More broadly, our results show that reinforcement learning can not only incentivize models to succeed, but also to reason about the limits of their capabilities and change course when they determine that success is out of reach.

items.title: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?
items.excerpt: Diffusion and flow matching are now dominant frameworks for generative modeling in continuous domains, but they typically require multiple network evaluations at inference. This has motivated extensive research on one-step generative modeling primarily built on diffusion and flow, though existing approaches often rely on complex training machinery. In this work, we introduce Priming Models, a simple two-stage framework for training one-step generators. Motivated by the difficulty of distributional training from scratch, Priming Models are first trained on a reconstruction objective, e.g., pixel-space denoising at a fixed noise level, before undergoing feature-space distributional post-training. Our central scientific finding is that this simple reconstruction stage is already enough to entirely alleviate the difficulty of distributional training. Empirically, across class-conditional image generation, text-to-image generation, and world modeling, Priming Models significantly advance the Pareto frontier of training compute vs. generation quality. On ImageNet at $256 \times 256$ resolution, we achieve a state-of-the-art FID of $1.19$ among one-step generators using approximately one-tenth the training compute of prior methods with comparable FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/priming.
items.summary: 本文提出Priming Models，一个先以固定噪声水平的像素空间去噪等重建目标预训练、再进行特征空间分布后训练的两阶段框架，用于训练一步生成器，并在类条件图像生成、文本到图像生成和世界模型任务上评估其训练计算量与生成质量之间的权衡。对科研工作而言，该工作提供的用途在于验证简单重建阶段可缓解从零开始分布训练的困难，并在ImageNet 256×256上报告了一步生成器中1.19的FID及约十分之一训练计算量；需注意这些对比和结论来自论文摘要及作者公开材料，未经过独立验证，且不表示已阅读完整全文。

items.title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
items.excerpt: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine parameter reuse with sparse computation to improve performance under matched budgets. Prior work demonstrates that different loop visits can play different roles even when they share parameters. To probe the contributions of different loop visits, we learn separate residual coefficients in a model that applies a shared block twice, observing a smaller scale in the first visit. Fixed coefficient experiments show that reducing the first visit's scale preserves or improves performance, whereas the same reductions to the second hurt it. This asymmetry motivates us to explore asymmetric compute allocation. We propose \textbf{LatentLoop}, which compresses the first visit's sequence, retains full resolution in the second, and reallocates saved computation to increase the hidden size. We further learn how strongly the first visit updates the full sequence, and share MoE weights across visits while using separate attention parameters to accommodate their different sequence resolutions. Across 15 configurations spanning 1.3B--7B parameters, with the largest budget exceeding $10^{21}$ FLOPs, LatentLoop consistently lowers validation NLL. At a fitted NLL of 1.988, predicted compute savings are 19.0\% and 7.9\% relative to vanilla MoE and the looped baseline. It also improves average scores on nine benchmarks at all sizes in 0-shot and 5-shot settings. These results suggest asymmetric compute allocation is a promising direction for looped MoE models.
items.summary: 本文提出LatentLoop，一种在循环MoE模型中压缩首次循环访问序列、保留第二次全分辨率并将节省算力重新分配给隐藏维度的非对称算力分配方法，且跨1.3B至7B参数的15种配置训练中报告验证NLL持续降低。对科研工作而言，该结果提示非对称算力分配是循环MoE模型值得探索的方向；但预测的算力节省（相对vanilla MoE为19.0%、相对循环基线为7.9%）基于拟合NLL与公司声明，尚属未经验证的结论，其性能优势需独立复现确认。

items.title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. Beyond final task performance, we examine training progress, stability, and measured computational cost. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, gains over GRPO remain limited in scope, with no method consistently outperforming it across settings. Second, strong final performance can mask unstable training. Third, additional training cost does not consistently translate into better performance. We establish this benchmark to support fair, comprehensive comparison and guide future research toward reliable and cost-effective improvements in agent training. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/
items.summary: 本文在同一实验条件下将十种代表性自蒸馏方法与GRPO在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA和WebShop四个任务及三种模型规模上进行了直接对比，共完成132次训练运行，并记录训练进度、稳定性与计算成本。该基准可用于支持更公平、全面的方法比较，并为后续智能体训练研究提供参考；但原文结论指出，这些方法相对GRPO的增益范围有限，且没有一种方法在所有设置下持续优于GRPO，同时较强的最终性能可能掩盖训练不稳定，额外训练成本也未必带来更好表现。

items.title: From scrap to prime: Designing high-performance alloys from dirty feedstocks with machine learning
items.excerpt: Producing alloys from recycled metals via secondary synthesis can markedly cut energy use, greenhouse-gas emissions, and dependence on scarce, strategically important elements relative to primary routes. The central obstacle is the feedstock itself: Scrap is chemically heterogeneous and unpredictable, a “dirty” mix whose impurities typically embrittle materials. Conventional strategies address this challenge by diluting impurities through the addition of virgin material, thereby restricting scrap utilization, limiting microstructural design freedom, and undermining cost and sustainability benefits. Here, we introduce a fundamentally different, data-driven paradigm that deliberately reverses a five-millennia-old metallurgical injunction: Rather than purifying the alloy, we design the alloy to accommodate and exploit its contaminants. Using a model ductile iron representative of 120 million metric tons of heavily contaminated scrap, we couple experiments with deep-neural-network optimization to identify chemically robust, impurity-tolerant processing windows. The resulting “dirty” irons retain ductility and strength by integrating impurity effects into a purposeful microstructure, rather removing them. The approach achieves complete recyclability, an 8.1% reduction in manufacturing cost, and mechanical gains of up to 15.2% in ultimate tensile strength and 73.2% in elongation at fracture. Crucially, it overcomes the canonical strength-ductility trade-off while enabling far greater scrap utilization and material circularity. By endowing alloys with a practical “gene of scrap compatibility,” this strategy reframes alloy design for a resource-constrained future and advances a mass-conserving circular economy for metals.

items.title: Risk-Controlled DFT Selection for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
items.excerpt: Automated materials discovery requires evaluating large pools of candidate configurations, with density functional theory (DFT) as a major throughput bottleneck. Pretrained machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate DFT cheaply, but their errors vary by orders of magnitude across configurations, making it difficult to decide when to trust the MLIP predictions and when to fall back to DFT. We frame this decision as a risk-controlled selection problem and solve it within a conformal risk control (CRC) framework. Each configuration is mapped from atomic numbers and Cartesian coordinates to a fixed geometric descriptor, which a lightweight predictor uses to estimate an MLIP-DFT disagreement score in energy, average force, and maximum force. CRC then calibrates this score into a selection threshold for DFT labeling such that the MLIP error on the unselected configurations, which keep their MLIP labels, stays below a user-chosen fraction $α$ of the expected error. Under an identical guarantee across eight dataset-MLIP pairs, our predictor routes 7% and 14% fewer configurations to DFT at $α=0.3$ than committee baselines. Because committee disagreement overlooks errors the MLIPs share, our gains are largest when the DFT labels and MLIP training data differ in DFT functional and basis set, and narrow when the two agree. Without model access, the structure-only predictor also ranks errors as well as the target MLIP's latent representation and outperforms widely used descriptors such as Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) and Atom-Centered Symmetry Functions (ACSF).
items.summary: 本文提出一种基于保形风险控制（CRC）的框架，用于在预训练机器学习原子间势（MLIP）与密度泛函理论（DFT）之间进行风险受控的选择：该方法用仅依赖结构的轻量预测器估计MLIP与DFT在能量、平均力和最大力上的不一致分数，并由CRC将该分数校准为DFT标注的选取阈值，使未被选中、保留MLIP标签的构型上的MLIP误差低于用户设定的期望误差比例。在相同的风险保证下，该方法可为MLIP–DFT路由提供有限样本的误差控制，并在八组数据集–MLIP配对上较委员会基线减少所需DFT调用；其增益在DFT标签与MLIP训练数据采用不同泛函或基组时最大、在二者一致时缩小，且该仅结构预测器不依赖目标MLIP的模型访问。

items.title: LabCompiler: A Framework for Verifiable Human-Machine Laboratory Execution from Imperfect Protocols
items.excerpt: Closing the loop of AI-driven science requires reliably translating natural-language protocols into executable laboratory workflows despite protocol defects and heterogeneous hardware. Existing approaches often couple scientific interpretation with device-specific code generation, making errors difficult to localize and limiting reuse across laboratory platforms. We introduce LabCompiler, a robust protocol-to-execution framework that transforms imperfect natural-language protocols into verifiable human-machine workflows. Its protocol firewall diagnoses and repairs defects before compilation while preserving unaffected content, guided by troubleshooting knowledge accumulated through perturbation-guided self-evolution. A two-level, device-agnostic graph representation separates experimental semantics from hardware-specific implementation and supports capability-based device assignment with coordinated human execution. We further introduce a protocol recovery benchmark covering four controlled perturbation types and naturally occurring errors collected from protocols written by iGEM participants. Experiments show that LabCompiler outperforms frontier LLMs in protocol error correction while enabling coordinated human-machine execution across heterogeneous, partially automated laboratory settings.
items.summary: 本文提出了LabCompiler框架，用于将不完整的自然语言实验方案先经方案防火墙诊断和修复缺陷，再编译为设备无关的两级图表示，并支持基于能力的设备分配与人机协同执行；实验报告显示其在方案纠错上优于前沿大语言模型，并能在异构、部分自动化的实验室环境中实现人机协同执行。该框架的用途是减少方案错误向下游执行的传播并支持跨异构硬件的复用，但原文指出其仅覆盖有限扰动类型与iGEM来源的自然错误，对无法由现有证据判定的科学歧义保留给人工澄清，且方案修复循环最多进行12次迭代，超出后视为未解决。

items.title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
items.excerpt: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards, which described how we measure and prevent political bias, detect misuse, and direct people to accurate voting information. Below, we outline how we've built on that work and continued to strengthen our election safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms. How people use Claude for elections and politics Our goal is for Claude to be a useful tool for political conversations, while preventing election-related abuse. That starts with understanding how people actually use Claude in these contexts. To do this, we used Anthropic Insights to develop a new analysis of 250,000 conversations over the course of a recent one-week period.1 Today, conversations that touch broadly on politics, public policy, or social issues account for about 5.75% of all conversations in the United States on Claude.ai, our consumer app. This includes people turning to Claude to follow the news, conduct academic or professional research on public policy, learn about candidates, and navigate government services. About 0.51% of all conversations are specifically about elections or voting. As we get closer to Election Day, we expect the share of political and election-related queries to increase. This sample suggests people rarely ask Claude whom or what to vote for. These kinds of requests showed up in about 0.01% of US Claude conversations. More often, we observed people asking Claude questions that could help them reach their own conclusions, like where candidates stand on a particular issue. Requests that violated our election integrity policies were even less common, appearing in about 0.002% of conversations.2 Connecting people to trusted sources Ahead of Election Day, we've added two ways for people to get reliable information directly in their conversations with Claude. As we shared in April, when people ask Claude.ai about voter registration, polling places, or election dates, we’ll continue to display a banner linking to TurboVote, a nonpartisan resource from Democracy Works. Later this month, Claude will start drawing official voting information from Democracy Works into its responses

CoTranslator: Reverse to Forward Chain-of-Thought Translator for Reasoning Distillation
items.excerpt: Reasoning distillation requires chain-of-thought (CoT) data with correct answers, but obtaining such data efficiently remains challenging. Forward CoT generation (FCG) followed by rejection sampling (RS) produces verified, question-only responses, yet may require many teacher calls for difficult problems. Reverse CoT generation (RCG) is cheaper because it conditions on the known answer, but access to this answer can lead to post-hoc rationalization and a mismatch with the student's answer-free inference setting. We propose CoTranslator, which learns to translate reverse CoT responses toward the distribution of verified forward responses. Trained on a small set of paired reverse and rejection-sampled forward responses, it supports large-scale generation and verification of student training data. Across six student models evaluated on six mathematics benchmarks, CoTranslator improves average accuracy over semantic suppression by up to 5.82 percentage points. For two 4B students, it retains 95.0% of rejection sampling's average accuracy while using 35.9% of its estimated compute. Without retraining, the same translator transfers to a new mathematics dataset, a different teacher, and STEM problems, improving average STEM accuracy by 4.88 and 4.31 percentage points for 4B and 8B students, respectively. These results show that CoTranslator offers an efficient and transferable approach to reasoning distillation.
items.summary: 本文提出CoTranslator，将依赖已知答案生成的反向思维链翻译为经过拒绝采样验证的前向思维链分布，并在少量配对数据上训练后用于大规模生成和验证学生训练数据。该方法面向推理蒸馏，可用于在减少教师模型调用次数的同时生成学生训练数据；但摘要所列精度提升与计算节省均为论文报告结果，其迁移到其他数据集、教师或STEM任务的效果及适用边界仍需以原文和后续验证为准。

items.title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
items.excerpt: Interactive video generation commonly relies on small bidirectional chunks to reduce response latency. Yet our preliminary experiments show that larger chunks improve video quality and better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Motivated by these observations, we propose Speculative Sampling, a strategy that combines the modeling power of large bidirectional windows with the low-latency interaction of small ones. It expands the modeling window by appending noise latents as padding and caches the resulting predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged. Predictions are delivered incrementally, while the uncommitted future remains replaceable. Our latency analysis shows that this removes the waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries, shifting the optimization focus from reducing chunk size to accelerating per-chunk sampling. Bidirectional window size thus becomes a decision variable for jointly optimizing visual quality and sampling time, rather than a necessary constraint on low-latency interaction. This opens a path to serving large bidirectional models in interactive streaming systems without complex streaming post-training.
items.summary: 本文提出推测采样策略，通过为建模窗口附加噪声潜变量作为填充并缓存条件不变时的预测结果，将大双向窗口的建模能力与小窗口的低延迟交互结合，并增量交付预测、保持未提交未来可替换。该工作可用于交互式视频生成中把双向窗口大小作为兼顾视觉质量与采样时间的决策变量，但其结论基于延迟分析，摘要未给出已验证的性能数字，且未涉及在交互式流系统中服务大双向模型所需的复杂流式后训练。

items.title: Lluna: Collaborative Unimodal Models for Missing-Modality Inference
items.excerpt: Pretrained unimodal models offer a flexible route to multimodal prediction through collaboration, but this collaboration can become less accurate than a surviving unimodal model when modalities are missing. We study this setting using fixed surviving-model anchors and find that collaborative gains can weaken or reverse as inputs disappear, even when the anchor's own input is unchanged. Our diagnostics further reveal reduced recovery of modality-specific information after aggregation and state-dependent collaborative representations. We propose Lluna, which combines a direct private prediction path from adapted unimodal features with a common graph-based collaboration branch that provides a residual correction. Progressive Collaboration Consistency organizes richer-to-poorer guidance along single-modality removals, aligning normalized common representations while task supervision adapts predictions to the available evidence. Across eight datasets spanning affective computing, scene understanding, and medical prediction, Lluna achieves the best evaluated average performance over non-full input states, improving Mean-Missing by 4.26\% on average relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. The fixed-anchor diagnostic also shows positive gains in mean collaboration under minimal inputs on all eight tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/Lluna.
items.summary: Lluna提出了一种结合适配单模态特征直接私有预测路径与图协作残差校正分支的方法，并采用渐进协作一致性在单模态逐步移除过程中对齐归一化公共表示，以适应可用的输入证据。在涵盖情感计算、场景理解和医学预测的八个数据集上，论文报告其在非完整输入状态下取得所评估的平均最佳性能，平均将Mean-Missing较最强评估基线改善4.26%，但该结论及固定锚诊断中的正向增益均来自作者在特定评估基准与设定下的结果，不应视为对全部缺失模态情形的普适性能保证。

items.title: Beyond Benchmark Accuracy: A Diagnostic Test for LLM Chemical Prediction
items.excerpt: LLMs have achieved strong performance on chemical prediction benchmarks. However, existing evaluation methods typically provide target entity identity information directly, making it difficult to determine whether model predictions arise from transferable structure-property reasoning capabilities or rely on target-related contextual information or memory retrieval. We propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic framework to evaluate chemical prediction models when target entity identity information is hidden. In this framework, the target is no longer directly defined by its entity identity, but instead by a known source entity and an explicit structural edit operation. This setting preserves the information required to determine the target while reducing the opportunity for models to access target identity cues. We evaluate this framework across six tasks spanning odor prediction, molecular property prediction, retrosynthesis, and reaction yield prediction. The results show that models generally achieve better prediction performance when source and target entity properties are consistent. Providing explicit source entity labels further strengthens this dependence. Moreover, while keeping the target entity, structural change, and ground-truth label unchanged, replacing only the source entity label causes some model predictions to systematically shift toward the substituted source labels. These results indicate that high benchmark accuracy in chemical prediction tasks does not necessarily imply that LLMs possess reliable structure-property reasoning capabilities. Our diagnostic framework provides a controlled evaluation approach for testing whether models can genuinely update predictions according to entity changes. The framework can be extended to other AI for Science tasks, particularly those where targets can be defined through transformations of known entities.
items.summary: 该论文提出“身份盲化推理诊断”框架，通过隐藏目标实体身份、仅用源实体和结构编辑操作定义目标来评估LLM，发现其在化学预测基准上的高分未必代表真正具备可迁移的结构—性质推理能力，而可能依赖目标身份线索或记忆检索。

items.title: Sorption Molecular Dynamics of Point Defects in 2D Materials with a Machine Learning Potential
items.excerpt: Defect engineering is a crucial tool for tuning and tailoring the properties of two-dimensional (2D) materials. A key challenge is identifying which defects are kinetically stable at room temperature and sufficiently promising to warrant further investigation. However, identifying stable defects with suitable properties using first-principles calculations, such as density functional theory (DFT) is computationally demanding, effectively limiting the scope of high-throughput studies. In this work, we investigate whether the machine learning interatomic potential MACE can reproduce sorption trends (adsorption vs. absorption) previously obtained from high-throughput DFT calculations and extend the analysis to elevated temperatures. A total of 17,624 defect structures from the ADAQ database are simulated using MACE-accelerated molecular dynamics (MD) at both 0 K and 300 K. The results show that MACE successfully reproduces the overall sorption trends observed in DFT calculations at 0 K at a fraction of the computational cost. Simulations performed at 300 K further indicate that the qualitative sorption trends remain largely the same when including finite-temperature effects. These findings demonstrate that MACE-driven MD can be used as an effective high-throughput prescreening tool for defect-related studies in 2D materials, specially related to sorption. While conventional first-principles methods, such as DFT, remain necessary for accurate and quantitative validation, the use of MLIPs enables MD simulations of finite-temperature defect behavior at a fraction of the computational cost of DFT-based MD.
items.summary: 该研究表明，机器学习势 MACE 能以远低于 DFT 的计算成本，在 0 K 和 300 K 下重现并扩展二维材料点缺陷的吸附/吸收趋势，从而可作为缺陷相关研究的高通量预筛选工具。

items.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
items.excerpt: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents'research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents'subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.
items.summary: SwarmRSI是一个通过演化科学智能体集群来实现递归自我改进的框架，它利用反馈引导的集群变异来修正假设或其实现，并通过互补集群重组复用保留的假设和程序组件以支持新研究。原文报告该框架在OpenProblems和NatureBench上取得SOTA结果，在MLE-Bench Lite上于81.8%的任务中获得奖牌，但这些比较和性能声明来自论文自身的评测，尚未经独立验证；摘要仅基于公开材料，未阅读完整全文。

Diminishing Returns of Data in Sparse Autoencoders: Functional Behavior does not Guarantee Feature Reproducibility
items.excerpt: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are typically trained on hundreds of millions to billions of activation tokens, yet little work has tested whether this scale is necessary. We study how much activation data SAEs need by training four SAE architectures on three language models with budgets ranging from 5M tokens to a 500M-token reference. We measure two notions of convergence: functional behavior on standard evaluations and one-to-one reproducibility of learned features. Functional data requirements are strongly metric-dependent: reconstruction often approaches the full-data reference at substantially smaller budgets, whereas feature reproducibility continues to improve with data. For Gemma-2-2B BatchTopK, the fraction of strictly matched features rises from 2\% at 5M tokens to 29\% at 50M. Data selection also matters: random sampling better preserves the original activation distribution and generally favors reconstruction, whereas diversity-based sampling frequently improves AutoInterp. A theoretical analysis separates statistical consistency of subsampled training from the stronger identifiability and optimization conditions required for one-to-one feature recovery. Our results show that SAE training can often be made far more data-efficient when budgets are matched to the goal, and feature-level claims are backed by explicit reproducibility checks, paving the way toward cheaper and more reliable SAE research.
items.summary: 本文在不同数据预算（5M至500M token）下训练四种稀疏自编码器（SAE）架构并覆盖三个语言模型，区分评估功能行为与特征一对一可复现性这两种收敛概念，同时比较随机采样与多样性采样的影响，并给出分离统计一致性与特征可识别性的理论分析。其用途在于提示SAE训练预算可按目标匹配以提高数据效率，且特征层面的结论需附带显式可复现性检查；原文限制为功能数据需求强烈依赖具体指标，特征可复现性随数据继续改善，其中Gemma-2-2B BatchTopK的严格匹配特征比例从5M token时的2%升至50M时的29%，故不能将功能收敛等同于特征可复现。

items.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
items.excerpt: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.
items.summary: 本文提出semCER，在保留CER对齐方式与分母的前提下，由LLM评判为每个字素编辑赋予严重程度权重，无需分词，并发布6100万条已评判编辑、聚合读者评分及蒸馏评分器。该指标可将整体转录分数拆解为具名编辑，用于按严重程度排序OCR或视觉语言模型错误，但材料指出其严重程度评分在跨语言间存在差异，例如对西班牙语变音或声调符号几乎不计分、对泰卢固语则接近错字母的严重程度。

items.title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
items.excerpt: When does a language model acquire a capability? Developmental studies usually answer this by tracking when models start producing the correct token. But that prediction passes through the unembedding matrix, or readout, which is itself still being learned during pretraining. We show that a model's hidden states can encode task information before its own readout expresses it, so timelines read from outputs conflate what the model encodes with what its readout expresses. To track the readout directly, we introduce parameter-trajectory crosscoding, which fits one sparse dictionary to every token's readout row at every checkpoint. Unlike crosscoders on activations, it needs only checkpoint weights. We use it to locate a narrow early window, 0.4-1.1% of the way through Pythia's pretraining, in which the readout reorganizes and WordNet word categories become decodable from its rows. By then, linear probes on the hidden states already decode task information that the model's own outputs do not yet show. To test whether such gaps depend on how fast the readout learns, we pretrain small models from scratch that differ only in the readout's learning rate. We find that raising it makes the readout develop earlier and the gap close sooner, with little effect on final loss. Together, these results imply that early in training, where many developmental transitions are dated, a behavioral date can reflect when the readout learns to express task information and not when the model learns it.
items.summary: 本文提出参数轨迹交叉编码方法，仅利用检查点权重拟合稀疏字典来追踪预训练中反嵌入矩阵（读出层）的动态，并在Pythia预训练早期0.4%–1.1%的窗口内定位到读出层的重组以及WordNet词类可从其行中解码的现象，同时通过仅改变读出层学习率的小模型从头预训练实验检验相关差距。对科研工作而言，该方法可用于区分模型何时编码任务信息与读出层何时能表达该信息，提示基于输出行为的发展时间线可能反映读出层的学习进度而非模型习得能力的时间，但相关结论均来自该公开摘要所述实验，尚未经独立验证，且不涉及完整全文。

items.title: Robust Explanatory Analysis for Structured Optimization Networks (REASON) in Learning
items.excerpt: We seek a hierarchical resolution of residual error under a composite learning objective as a principled mechanism for identifying and exploiting additional information, particularly under distribution shift and perturbation. Inspired by the System 1/System 2 paradigm, we formulate this principle as a two-loop mechanism serving a common inference goal. A fast, System 1-like loop resolves the residual addressable by the available evidence; the remaining epistemic residual triggers a medium speed, System 2-like loop that actively acquires additional evidence and measures its informational value through residual reduction. Over nested solution spaces, the medium-loop optimum is provably no worse than the fast-loop optimum. Experiments show that the resulting two-loop model consistently improves upon the fast loop at approximately half the computation of the medium loop, including under unseen corruptions, and, when provided a cleaner observation, outperforms staged classifiers and learning-to-defer methods at equal computational cost.

items.title: Recognition Is Not Grounding: Benchmarking Multilingual Financial Evidence Extraction
items.excerpt: Comparing financial disclosures across languages requires identifying shared accounting concepts and recovering all numerical facts that express them. Existing benchmarks evaluate aspects of these capabilities, but provide limited insight into whether both succeed on the same multilingual evidence. In particular, it remains unclear whether language models can recognize these concepts across languages and exhaustively recover their corresponding numerical evidence from the same contexts. We introduce MULTIFINGROUND, a benchmark designed to investigate this recognition-grounding gap in multilingual financial reports. Constructed from FY2025 disclosures of 90 issuers in English, French, and Greek, MULTIFINGROUND aligns independently authored reports through a shared accounting taxonomy and provides traceable fact-level annotations. The benchmark evaluates financial fact identification, concept recognition, exhaustive fact selection, and concept discrimination without candidate labels. Across 15 evaluated models, eight API and open-weight reference models achieve 97.3-99.4\% concept recognition accuracy, yet miss at least one target fact in 26.6-41.9\% of correctly recognized groups. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in concept discrimination and limited gains from the evaluated finance-specialized models. Our findings demonstrate that strong concept recognition can coexist with incomplete evidence recovery, highlighting the importance of evaluating semantic recognition and evidence completeness together.

CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
items.excerpt: AI agents are demonstrating increasingly strong offensive and defensive cybersecurity capabilities in the real world. Current benchmarks mostly evaluate agents in isolation against static targets. Real cyber operations, however, are dynamic and coupled: security postures constantly change as attackers and defenders adapt to each other in real time. Static benchmarks quickly saturate and miss an agent's ability to attack and defend simultaneously under live pressure. To address this gap, we present CyberArena, a dynamic, symmetric adversarial benchmark built around multi-round attack-and-defense combat. In isolated sandboxes, two agents compete under identical rules, acting concurrently as both attackers and defenders over continuously changing services. This converts static targets into evolving, semi-open challenges, directly testing an agent's speed and precision in discovering, exploiting, and patching vulnerabilities. To sustain the benchmark's longevity, an automated agentic pipeline continuously generates, reviews, and validates new environments. Furthermore, because pairwise contests are notoriously hard to quantify, we introduce a dynamical model that maps match dynamics into unified, multidimensional scores across offensive, defensive, and domain-specific capabilities. Evaluating 12 frontier LLM agents across 40 challenges in 466 matches, CyberArena separates model capabilities where single-agent baselines hit a ceiling. The trajectories read like a fight rather than an exam: defenders patch one hole and miss the next and certify repairs on stale evidence, while capable agents think a move ahead, planting backdoors for later rounds and, in one case, writing their own packet sniffer to watch the opponent. Beyond a benchmark, CyberArena serves as an adaptable, scalable experimental platform for future research on cybersecurity agents.
items.summary: 本文提出 CyberArena，一个基于多轮攻防对抗的动态对称基准，并在隔离沙箱中让两个智能体在相同规则下同时充当攻击方和防御方，通过自动化流水线持续生成和验证新环境，同时引入将比赛动态映射为多维能力的评分模型。该基准可用于在持续变化且相互耦合的条件下评测智能体的攻防能力，并作为可扩展实验平台支持后续网络安全智能体研究；其公开材料未给出完整全文，相关公司声明或评测结论仍需独立验证，且未在此摘要中采用未经验证的具体性能数字。

items.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
items.excerpt: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
items.summary:
本文提出混合推理智能体（HybridAgents），通过轻量级HybridLink在潜空间推理与文本交互之间动态切换，并配套HybridSFT与HybridRL后训练算法，以在统一生成过程中保留工具调用能力。  
原文报告其在数学、科学、医学、检索与智能体推理等11项基准、3种模型规模上相对前沿LLM智能体及智能体框架平均提升10.4%，并报告token减少35.5%–54.7%、推理加速1.8–2.6倍、成本节省2.7–3.7倍；这些为原文声明指标，尚待独立验证，且不声称已阅读完整全文。

items.title: RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks
items.excerpt: It is difficult to accurately model the physics of the interaction between a robot and the objects it manipulates, including contact mechanics, coupled contact dynamics, deformations, stiffness and friction. We present RoboSimStudio (RSS), an interactive toolkit that makes choices of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable, allowing both humans and coding agents to iteratively refine simulations based on observed physical behavior. We implement RSS with the open Newton physics simulation system and describe experiments with human-guided real2sim using (1) visual evaluation, (2) force-feedback and (3) agentic Real2Sim2Real. Code, video and additional information can be found on the project website.
items.summary: 本文提出并实现了RoboSimStudio这一交互式工具包，将求解器、接触模型和物理参数的选择显式化并可编辑，以便人类和编码代理根据观测到的物理行为迭代优化仿真，并在Newton物理仿真系统上开展了人工引导的Real2Sim实验。该工具包可用于机器人操作任务中真机到仿真的快速转换研究，但原文摘要未报告其精度或性能指标，其有效性尚需依据公开的实验与评估进一步核实。

items.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
items.excerpt: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon
items.summary: 本文提出CarryOn，一种面向对象的上下文运行时，用“延续载体”绑定可复用内容或对象引用及其使用条件，并联合执行上下文与近期交互尾部，在折叠时只修订受影响的载体记录、沿用未受影响记录。该工作可用于长时程智能体的上下文组织与任务延续研究，但所报告的OSWorld 2.0与BrowseComp-Plus性能提升及token、成本下降均为原文实验声明，尚未经独立验证，且摘要材料未给出跨任务、跨模型或超出所测基准的适用性证据。

items.title: Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports
items.excerpt: Evaluation for automatic crisis reporting should measure what practitioners need, not what is convenient to compare. Through LLM-assisted, author-approved content analysis, we derive a 15-slot information schema from professional humanitarian situation reports using qualitative content analysis, then evaluate 121 human and 261 LLM-generated reports across five disasters and three hazard types. Under google/gemini-3.7-flash on Cyclone Idai, the best machine arm is nominally above the empirical human ceiling (0.827 vs. 0.821), but the difference is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95\% bootstrap CI [-.049,.059]; permutation p=.852), and the ordering does not replicate under openai/gpt-5.6-luna. On a blind 100-item Idai sample, the author agrees with the Gemini judge at 0.910 accuracy and unweighted Cohen's κ=.799. All four judges clear the plan's raw-agreement criterion of .7; only Gemini reaches .7 on chance-corrected κ. Across the three primary events, machine reports reproduce 5.4-11.0% of same-day official figures. Across those same events, raw exact-number matching links 14.3-19.6% of official figures and 85.4-90.1% of machine figures to the social stream; manual audit confirms 45/50 declared absences, 4/25 official matches, and 24/25 machine matches semantically. The issuing-provenance gap is positive in all 12 observed event-judge cells: report date, organisation, series, and authority were not supplied at professional-report coverage in any cell. On the three primary events, ROUGE-L is uninformative, BERTScore is negatively associated with completeness after multiplicity correction, and a generic LLM judge changes sign.
items.summary: 本文从专业人道主义局势报告中提炼出15项信息槽位模式，并对五个灾害、三类灾害类型的121份人工报告与261份大语言模型生成报告进行对比评估，检验其与当日官方数据的吻合度及信息来源可追溯性。该评估框架可用于衡量自动危机报告是否满足从业者实际需要，但结果受限于特定模型与事件，模型在部分指标上的优势未达统计显著且未在其他模型上复现，官方数据复现比例较低，来源可追溯性在所有观测单元中均未达到专业报告覆盖水平。
