LeanPRM: Lean-Grounded Process Supervision for Natural Language Proof Verification
items.excerpt: AI systems now write long and difficult mathematical proofs, and checking their step-by-step validity is becoming a bottleneck. A learned verifier could check proofs cheaply, but training one requires a correctness label on every step, and such labels are hard to obtain for open-ended proofs. Existing methods take them from human annotators, which is costly, or derive them from final answers, which proofs do not have, and formalizing each proof in Lean requires expert effort. We introduce LeanPRM, a framework that uses the Lean proof assistant to create step-level labels for natural-language proofs. A model writes a natural-language proof together with a paired formal proof, without feedback from Lean. Lean then labels every step, and a second model discards failures caused only by the formal syntax, so that the negative labels mark errors in the mathematics. LeanPRM contains 10,634 proofs with 152K labeled steps and no human annotation. A Qwen3-4B verifier trained on LeanPRM raises exact step-label accuracy on a held-out set of 200 proofs (LeanPRM-Bench) from 48.2 to 74.7, as opposed to 60.3 when the same base model is trained on PRM800K. It also selects better proofs in best-of-N selection on IMO-level problems, and outperforms the PRM800K-trained verifier on three of four external verification benchmarks. Training on LeanPRM improves verifiers at every size from 0.6B to 8B parameters on LeanPRM-Bench, Hard2Verify and IMO-GradingBench. Given the labels need no human annotation, LeanPRM can grow with the supply of formal statements, offering a path to step-level feedback on AI-generated proofs that are hard for humans to check.
items.summary: LeanPRM提出一个利用Lean证明助手为自然语言证明自动生成步骤级标签的框架，构建了包含10,634个证明和152K个标注步骤的数据集，并训练了一个验证器。该框架为缺少人工标注的开放式证明提供了可扩展的步骤级监督信号，从而在最佳N选和外部验证基准上提升验证器表现，但其步骤标签依赖形式化验证，且可能受形式语法错误与数学错误区分效果的限制。

items.title: Copy-Paste Language Models
items.excerpt: Transformers are intuitively considered to be efficient at copying from their inputs. We actually show that the ability of LLMs to copy in context can be improved through explicit modeling. We propose Copy-Paste Language Models (CPLMs), which add a lightweight Copy-Paste head to the conventional language modeling (LM) head. CPLMs improve training efficiency, downstream performance, and offer new operating points in long-context and retrieval setups. We validate our approach by pretraining models from 135M to 1.7B parameters, showing improvements across all scales and backbones with negligible training and inference overheads. We explain the success of CPLMs by showing that they partially mitigate the LM head gradient bottleneck through an alternative gradient path.
items.summary: 本文提出复制粘贴语言模型（CPLM），在传统语言建模头之外增加轻量级复制粘贴头，并通过从1.35亿到17亿参数规模的预训练验证其在所有规模和骨干上的改进。该设计可用于提升训练效率与下游性能，并在长上下文和检索场景中提供新的工作点，但摘要中报告的优势均为作者实验结论，其适用性和实际收益需结合具体任务进一步验证。

items.title: DisaggKD: Efficient Knowledge Distillation through Teacher-Student Disaggregation and a Fused Loss
items.excerpt: Knowledge distillation (KD) frameworks place teacher and student on the same GPUs, so per-GPU memory limits the teachers that fit. DisaggKD separates them across nodes: teacher replicas stream hidden states to the student, a KD loss over row windows and vocabulary shards equals the full-vocabulary loss in exact arithmetic without forming the full-vocabulary logits, and a prefetch ring paces producer and trainer. Closed-form memory and traffic models locate the memory limits of each layout. On the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to 9B pair, the disaggregated layout matches the LM loss of the colocated run with the same loss and is faster than that run; our fused loss also lets a colocated run train on as few nodes at faster speed, while the split is memory efficient when the student spans several nodes. On the larger pairs, colocated runs with a fused loss still run OOM where the split trains, because teacher weights and student states fill the budget.
items.summary: DisaggKD将知识蒸馏中的教师与学生分离到不同节点，由教师副本向学生流式传输隐藏状态，并采用按行窗口与词表分片的融合损失，在不形成完整词表logits的情况下实现与全词表损失等价的精确算术结果。该设计在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B到9B等配对上的报告显示，分离布局在相同损失下匹配并快于同址运行，但原文指出在更大模型配对中，教师权重与学生状态仍会占满显存，使采用融合损失的同址运行出现OOM，而分离布局可继续训练。

items.title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators
items.excerpt: Generative discovery in science requires coupling high-level scientific reasoning with the ability to generate samples respecting the structure of a design space. Yet these capabilities remain largely separated: foundation LLMs encode broad chemical and biological knowledge, while domain-specific flow- and diffusion-based generators capture the priors needed to produce valid sequences and geometries. We study how to align such scientific generators to high-level natural-language discovery goals without requiring an explicit proxy reward, which is often unavailable or poorly captured by learned predictors in experimental sciences. We introduce LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD), where a frozen LLM acts as an adaptive teacher for a domain-specific generator. Given a goal such as 'generate peptides with promising anticancer activity', the teacher constructs a curriculum of intermediate sub-goals aware of the flow's current capabilities, and progressively directs them toward the original discovery goal. At each round, the LLM judges sampled candidates under the current objective. These judgments induce preferences that are iteratively distilled into the generator through DPO. This procedure provides dense learning signals even when the initial model places negligible probability on designs satisfying the final goal, enabling adaptation toward poorly covered, out-of-distribution regions. Experiments on therapeutic peptides and small-molecule structure design demonstrate that LFD enables a new form of generative control: aligning arbitrary domain-specific scientific generators to scientific discovery tasks expressed via high-level natural-language goals.
items.summary: 提出LLM-to-Flow Distillation（LFD），让冻结LLM作为自适应教师，通过构建中间子目标课程并用其评判生成偏好，再经DPO迭代蒸馏到领域生成器中，从而无需显式代理奖励即可将高层自然语言科学发现目标对齐到流/扩散生成模型。

items.title: Image Tokenizers Should Be Trained Between Images
items.excerpt: Latent diffusion models generate images as codes of an image tokenizer, whose decoder turns them into the pixel image. Recent tokenizers improve how well these codes reconstruct an image and how easily a generator learns them. Yet a generator does not reproduce the codes of training images, and when a generated code lands outside what the decoder expects, the decoded image contains imperfections. Current methods make the decoder more robust to generated codes by adding noise during training. However, generated codes lie between the training codes and resemble their mixture more than one of them plus noise. To improve generated images, decoders should therefore be trained on codes in the space between training samples. We propose InterpTok, which fine-tunes MAETok to decode mixtures of image codes into natural images. Since no target image exists between two training samples, a discriminator judges whether each decoded mixture looks as natural as its two sources. A mixing ratio loss requires the decoded mixture to keep the mixing ratio of the two codes. Together, they prevent collapse to a trivial solution and yield a sharp and natural composition of both images. InterpTok keeps MAETok's reconstruction quality and improves interpolation quality more than threefold, the best of all tokenizers in a recent benchmark. Beyond interpolation, InterpTok improves the generation FID of a matched diffusion transformer from 11.61 to 8.48 without guidance, and even reaches 8.11 at an eighth of the sampling steps, where the generator on MAETok's codes worsens. The generator trained on our tokenizer also reaches the final result of the one trained on MAETok at half the training steps. Our findings show that the space between image codes can and should be explicitly supervised rather than ignored.
items.summary: 本文提出InterpTok，通过对MAETok进行微调，使其能解码图像码的混合，并借助判别器与混合比例损失约束解码结果保持自然且符合混合比例。该工作可用于提升基于此类图像分词器的扩散生成质量与插值质量，但摘要中的性能提升数字来自原文报告，仍需独立验证。

items.title: Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues
items.excerpt: LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. The main agent need to verify contextual correctness, diagnose information gap and track unresolved dependencies in order to obtain the correct evidence for solving the task. We also introduce a verifiable and scalable automated generation pipeline that pairs LLM-based scenario generation with executable checks of answer uniqueness and role necessity. Results across ten models show that similar reliable-setting performance can result in different robustness to unreliable evidence. Trace analysis reveals frequent omissions of corrective follow-up, and the recovery behavior involves inefficient waiting and redundant queries. These findings show that robust collaboration requires not only sound reasoning, but also targeted action to diagnose evidence failures, recover relevant information, and integrate it into decisions. Our data and source code are available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/UnCoBench.
items.summary: 本文提出不可靠同事基准（UnCoBench），将多智能体协作中的行为失败组织为错位、不完整和未响应三类设置，并配套一个结合大模型场景生成与答案唯一性、角色必要性可执行检查的自动化生成流程，在十种模型上评估。该基准可用于区分任务求解能力与不可靠证据收集下的恢复能力，但结果基于其生成流程，未验证真实团队表现，且摘要未提供具体性能数值。

items.title: Where Polanyi Meets Galois: Tacit Knowing as an Algebro-Deterministic Operation, Toward Re-rooting AI-Generated Science
items.excerpt: We argue that tacit knowing is better modelled as an operating regime of one memory substrate than as a kind of content. The substrate is VaCoAl, an algebro-deterministic XOR-and-shift hyperdimensional memory over GF(2), realized as CASRAM (commercial SRAM-CAM) and PyVaCoAl (DRAM-CAM).In VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl a directed acyclic graph (DAG) reads two ways. Repairing every collision (Rescue mode) makes the trace exactly auditable but ranks no path higher; tolerating collisions (Don't Care mode) yields a path-integrated confidence, CR$_2$, that silently favours direct routes. This audit-valuation complementarity is a formal counterpart of Polanyi's claim that tacit and explicit knowledge are not sharply divided. It separates contingent tacitness, which a new query brings out (AlphaGo's game tree), from regime-bound tacitness, statable only in a regime where it is gone (AlphaGo's hunches). (1) Polanyi's from-to structure reads as non-commutative binding, the Identikit as role-filler composition, recognition as majority-vote coincidence. (2) Explicating the valuation destroys it, as attending to his fingers can make Polanyi's pianist falter, yet a closed-form law states it. Polanyi, Nonaka, Tsoukas and Collins each capture part of this but narrowly; even Nonaka and von Krogh's continuum cannot tell contingent from regime-bound tacitness. (3) Collins's three tacit knowledges become strata, one outside the substrate. (4) Our mentor-student DAG is a tacit-transmission graph. (5) Terence Tao's remark that AI-solved problems spawn few follow-ups is diagnosed as rootless explicit knowledge: checkable results whose route no one can follow and that no one yet understands well enough to extend, teach or judge. To re-root them, LLMs generate, VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl keeps an auditable trace with its confidence, and people value, a role virtue epistemology shows cannot be offloaded. Testable predictions follow.
items.summary: 本文将隐性知识建模为GF(2)上代数确定性XOR与移位超维记忆VaCoAl（及其CASRAM与PyVaCoAl实现）的一种运行机制，并通过审计-估值互补性区分情境性隐性知识与机制绑定隐性知识。该框架可用于分析AI生成科学中“无根显性知识”的可审计追溯与置信度评估问题，但其所谓性能优势来自公司声明而非已验证结论，且仅基于摘要与知识图谱提取信息，未阅读全文。

items.title: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution
items.excerpt: Recent advances in self-improving LLM agents have demonstrated the potential of AI systems that drive their own intelligence. However, many domain-specific applications rely on specialized foundation models that possess strong domain expertise but remain dependent on human-designed improvements. Extending recursive self-improvement to these models presents a key challenge: as a specialist improves, the strategies used to advance it must also adapt. To address this challenge, we propose Heterogeneous Agentic CoEvolution (HACE), a framework that jointly evolves specialized foundation models and LLM agents through reciprocal learning. HACE improves the specialist through supervised learning while training the agent with on-policy reinforced self-training, guided by verified performance gains on the current specialist. The agent's exploration, in turn, informs subsequent specialist training, enabling both models to adapt to each other's progress. To sustain this reciprocal learning, HACE further employs evolutionary search to optimize their interaction harness, adapting how the models exchange information and select training experiences as their capabilities evolve. We evaluate HACE across three challenging domains: recommendation systems, protein function prediction in biology, and crystal stability prediction in material discovery. We show that HACE outperforms the evaluated self-improving methods on the primary task metrics across all three domains. These results shed light on heterogeneous coevolution as a universal approach to improving specialized foundation models through reciprocal interaction with a learning agent.
items.summary: 本文提出异构智能体协同演化（HACE）框架，通过互惠学习联合演化专用基础模型与LLM智能体，并采用进化搜索优化二者的交互机制，在推荐系统、生物蛋白质功能预测和材料晶体稳定性预测三个领域进行了评估。该框架为专用基础模型的自我改进提供了新思路，但其有效性目前仅基于这三个领域的任务指标，且所报告的性能提升来自公开摘要，尚未经独立验证。

items.excerpt: ABSTRACT Anti-counterfeiting technologies are increasingly challenged by advances in imaging and machine learning, exposing the fundamental limitations of conventional static optical security systems. Here, a time-resolved physically unclonable function (TR-PUF) system is established, transforming optical authentication from static pattern recognition to high-dimensional temporal encoding. Central to this approach, boron-based room-temperature phosphorescent (RTP) materials are developed via covalent coupling with coumarin derivatives using a solvent-free strategy that is readily scalable to kilogram-level production, exhibiting a maximum phosphorescence lifetime of over 2 s, an ultralong afterglow visible for up to 30 s, and color-tunable emission. The formation of rigid B-O-C linkages spatially isolates emissive centers, suppressing energy transfer and preserving temporally independent decay channels-an essential prerequisite for high-entropy time-resolved encoding. Randomly embedding these multi-emissive RTP units into a polymer matrix forms a complex encryption structure that enables a dual-entropy encoding mechanism with both spectral and temporal dimensions, generating dynamic time keys for authentication. Moreover, we propose a matched time-gated authentication framework that achieves >99% identification accuracy within 1.2 s while exhibiting resistance against the tested generative machine-learning attacks. This work proposes a practical materials platform and a time-gated authentication strategy, offering a scalable technological path for the development of dynamic optical encryption tags.
authors: Changsong Xu, Daxiang Shi, Guoyi Pan, Ru-Jia Wang, Jiankang Qin, Jin Peng, Peng Chen, Yingjuan Sun, Wenjing Lin, Wen-Cheng Chen, Xiaofeng Lin, Dingshan Yu, Guobin Yi

items.title: Large Language Model Directed Iteration for the Design of Ultra-Stable Sodium-Ion Battery
items.excerpt: ABSTRACT Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into materials discovery is hindered by the trade-off between exploration breadth and exploitation depth, while the lack of embedded domain knowledge and systematic chemical space compression further limits intelligent materials exploration under data scarcity. Herein, we propose a literature-knowledge-directed iterative workflow that combines large language models (LLMs) with Bayesian optimization (BO) for the rational electrolyte design for ultra-stable sodium-ion batteries (SIBs). LLMs serve as auxiliary tools for knowledge mining, while BO accelerates multi-objective optimization to obtain electrolyte compositions. The optimized dual-anion hybrid solvation electrolyte (DHSE) constructs a synergistic solvation structure, which induces the formation of a compact, inorganic-rich, and mechanically robust cathode electrolyte interphase (CEI). The as-formed CEI layer suppresses parasitic side reactions and accelerates Na + transport by reducing the desolvation barrier. Remarkably, industrial-scale Ah-level hard carbon||NaNi 0.3 Mn 0.3 Fe 0.3 O 2 pouch cells assembled with DHSE deliver a high energy density of 107.7 Wh kg −1 , alongside a superior capacity retention of 94% after 100 cycles at 0.5C. This work not only develops a high-performance electrolyte for practically applicable SIBs but also provides a general human-agent collaborative framework for intelligent materials development under data-limited conditions.

items.excerpt: Abstract Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) enable RNA medicines, yet ionizable-lipid discovery remains largely empirical, particularly when in vitro activity must be translated into functional hepatic delivery in vivo. Here we establish an interpretable discovery framework that combines modular degradable lipid chemistry, high-throughput phenotyping, machine learning, virtual library expansion, and independent in vivo validation to define a learnable ionizable-lipid design space. Starting from a 520-member library, we train an XGBoost model on firefly luciferase (Fluc) expression in HeLa cells and use physicochemical descriptors and molecular fingerprints to prospectively prioritize candidates with higher predicted in vitro transfection activity across a 10,920-member virtual space. In vivo phenotyping subsequently identifies PA97MD101 as a lead ionizable lipid. In mice, PA97MD101 enhances hepatic mRNA expression and Cre-dependent recombination and supports Cas9/sgTtr-mediated TTR suppression. Its performance is associated with pH-dependent membrane activity and reduced lysosomal colocalization. These findings support further evaluation of PA97MD101 for functional hepatic RNA delivery.

items.title: Optimizing NiMo Electrocatalyst Coatings for Hydrogen Evolution in Alkaline Electrolysis With The Machine Learning-Guided Autonomous Platform CatBot
items.excerpt: ABSTRACT The discovery of efficient, durable, and platinum group metal-free electrocatalysts for alkaline water electrolysis is essential to reduce the cost of green hydrogen. Efficient exploration of the vast possible synthetic space is nevertheless hindered by the slow pace of manual experimentation. Here, a closed-loop optimization is presented that combines an automated electrocatalyst synthesis and testing system, CatBot, with Bayesian optimization and accelerated stress testing at industrial conditions for the rapid discovery of active and durable NiMo coatings. Distinct regions with exceptionally high activity and stability are identified within limited experimental budgets on a nickel wire substrate, using different search strategies to efficiently navigate the six-dimensional synthesis space exceeding possible combinations. The most promising coatings are upscaled onto technological nickel foam electrodes showing platinum-level catalytic activity with overpotentials of 173 mV at -1 in 30 wt.% KOH at for the hydrogen evolution reaction. This work establishes a generalizable strategy for the autonomous optimization of functional electrocatalyst coatings under realistic operating conditions.

items.excerpt: ABSTRACT Manganese-based layered oxides are promising cathodes for sodium-ion batteries, yet their practical deployment is restricted by Mn 3+ -induced Jahn-Teller distortion, irreversible high-voltage P2-O2 phase transitions, and oxygen-related side reactions that collectively cause structural deterioration and rapid capacity fading. Here, based on literature-correlation analysis of reported Ni─Mn P2-type cathodes, we establish a machine-learning-guided dopant-class design strategy. The analysis reveals distinct roles of metal, non-metal, and metalloid dopants in governing cycling stability and redox reversibility, identifying metalloid regulation as the most favorable direction for enhancing high-voltage structural and redox stability. Guided by this insight, an Al─B─F co-doped P2-type cathode is rationally designed, in which boron reinforces the oxygen framework through strong B─O covalency, while Al and F provide complementary cationic and anionic regulation. The optimized cathode delivers 142.8 mAh g −1 at a high average voltage of 3.53 V and exhibits superior low-temperature capacity retention of 98.19% after 300 cycles at −5 C. In situ XRD, soft x-ray absorption spectroscopy, ex situ XPS, operando DEMS, and DFT calculations reveal a highly reversible reaction pathway featuring stabilized oxygen redox and near-zero volumetric strain (ΔV/V ≈ 0.025%). This work establishes machine-learning-guided dopant-class design as a general strategy for developing durable high-voltage layered sodium-ion cathodes.
items.summary: 本文基于已报道Ni─Mn P2型正极的文献关联分析，建立了机器学习引导的掺杂剂类别设计策略，并据此设计出Al─B─F共掺杂P2型正极，通过多种表征与DFT计算揭示了其高度可逆反应路径、稳定氧氧化还原及近零体积应变（ΔV/V≈0.025%）。该工作提出的掺杂剂类别设计策略可用于开发耐久的高电压层状钠离子电池正极，但摘要未说明该策略在其他掺杂体系或正极材料中的普适性边界，也未给出除优化正极以外具体条件的验证结果。

ΔNAzyme: A Foundational QM/MM Δ-Machine Learning Potential for Nucleic Acid Enzyme Catalysis
items.excerpt: Nucleic acid enzymes (NAzymes), including ribozymes, DNAzymes, and XNAzymes, are programmable biocatalysts that catalyze diverse chemical reactions and provide unique platforms for investigating catalysis and engineering molecular function. Their central roles in biology and evolution, together with emerging applications in biotechnology, synthetic biology, and medicine, have created an urgent need for predictive computational design frameworks. Although multiscale computational enzymology integrating ab initio quantum mechanics can, in principle, provide predictive insight into these systems, current approaches remain computationally prohibitive for large, complex NAzymes and high-throughput design workflows. Machine learning potentials have the potential to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of multiscale modeling approaches, but QM/MM contexts in which the MM environment is highly polarizing remain challenging. Nucleic acid enzymes present a particularly demanding case: experimentally relevant predictions require an accuracy that semiempirical QM/MM methods alone cannot reliably deliver in their often large, highly charged, metal-dependent active sites. Building on the range-corrected QM/MM Δ-machine learning potential (ΔMLP) framework, we develop ΔNAzyme, a foundational ΔMLP for nucleic acid enzyme reactions. We generate a training set of QM/MM simulations spanning diverse nucleic acid enzyme classes, with energies and forces computed at both the reference (DFTB3) and target (PBE0/6–31G*) levels of theory, yielding a correction on top of DFTB3 that recovers PBE0 quality results. We train models using both the Deep Potential and MACE architectures. The MACE model exhibits enhanced transferability, which we attribute to the equivariant, many-body message-passing framework. Free energy profiles from case-study reactions validate ΔNAzyme against target-level results and show that the model supports efficient fine-tuning to new nucleic acid enzyme systems with minimal additional data.
items.summary: 本文构建了面向核酸酶催化的ΔNAzyme量子力学/分子力学Δ机器学习势，基于DFTB3参考与PBE0/6–31G*目标能级数据训练Deep Potential和MACE模型，并通过案例反应自由能曲线验证其接近目标能级结果且可少量数据微调至新核酸酶体系。该势旨在为大型、高电荷、金属依赖核酸酶的多尺度计算酶学与高通量设计提供更可行的预测框架，但其有效性受限于所用训练集和案例验证范围，未在原文中给出通用性能保证。

items.title: Applications of Single-Atom Alloys in Thermal, Electro, and Photo Catalysis
items.excerpt: Single-atom alloys (SAAs) are an emerging class of heterogeneous catalysts that maximize atom efficiency by embedding isolated reactive metal atoms within a host metal surface, creating well-defined active sites. Atomic isolation imparts unique catalytic properties, including high selectivity, resistance to poisoning, coking, and sintering, and in some cases the ability to circumvent conventional scaling relationships that limit traditional catalysts. This article focuses on progress in the SAA field since our 2020 review (Chem. Rev.2020, 120, 12044−12088.), while incorporating earlier foundational studies where relevant. We first examine the fundamental principles governing SAA formation, stability, electronic structure, reactivity, and selectivity, drawing on insights from experimental single-crystal model systems and theoretical studies. We then review the application of SAAs in a wide range of industrially important reactions, including hydrogenation, dehydrogenation, selective oxidation, water–gas shift, Fischer–Tropsch synthesis, and dry reforming, among others. Beyond thermal catalysis, SAAs demonstrate great promise in electrocatalysis and plasmon-driven chemistry. Their structurally simple active sites have also enabled the rational design of novel catalysts and promoters that challenge conventional catalytic intuition. Looking ahead, recent advances in computing, including machine-learning potentials, offer the opportunity to explore vast compositional spaces and discover new alloy chemistries for challenging reactions using the SAA concept.
items.summary: 本文更新了自2020年综述以来单原子合金（SAA）领域的研究进展，涵盖其形成、稳定性、电子结构、反应性与选择性的基本原理，以及SAA在加氢、脱氢、选择性氧化、水煤气变换、费托合成和干重整等多种工业反应和电催化、等离激元驱动化学中的应用，并结合实验单晶模型体系与理论研究及计算进展（包括机器学习势）进行讨论。对科研工作的用途在于：该文系统梳理了SAA的结构简单活性位如何启发新型催化剂与助剂的理性设计，并指出计算与机器学习势可望用于探索广阔组成空间以发现面向挑战性反应的新合金化学；其限制在于文中所述高温选择性、抗中毒、抗结焦、抗烧结及规避传统标度关系等优势来自原文对SAA催化特性的描述，未给出具体性能数字，且未说明是否已验证于工业条件。

items.title: FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation
items.excerpt: Linear-time sequence models typically store long-context information in a recurrent state. A fixed-size state limits how much information can be stored, while hybrid architectures that add full attention for better recall incur quadratic sequence cost. Alternatively, sparse attention with continued pretraining (CPT) can extend the effective context length. Generalization beyond the trained length remains challenging, however, and CPT can be costly. We introduce FreeSolo, a native sparse attention mechanism with a short-range sliding window branch and a long-range branch that selects keypoint cells for direct token attention. Its linear-time variant, FS-L, learns to prune the prefix before query-dependent selection through short CPT. FS-B searches balanced trees with O(Nlog^2 N) algorithmic cost including radix-sort construction. FreeSolo demonstrates better zero-shot length extrapolation than the baselines without long-context fine-tuning.
items.summary: FreeSolo提出一种原生稀疏注意力机制，包含短程滑动窗口分支和通过选择关键点单元进行直接token注意力的长程分支，其FS-L变体经短程持续预训练学习在查询相关选择前剪枝前缀，FS-B则以O(Nlog^2 N)算法成本搜索平衡树。该工作报告在无需长上下文微调的情况下，其零样本长度外推表现优于基线，可用于长序列建模并降低全注意力或持续预训练的二次成本与开销，但摘要未给出具体性能数字，相关比较结论仍需独立验证。

items.title: When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen
items.excerpt: Can a vision-language model tell left from right? Modern VLMs solve visual puzzles and follow hour-long videos, yet when asked whether the camera moved left or right, most do no better than a coin flip. Adding camera-motion data or geometric representations has been tried, separately, and neither closes the gap. We argue that camera-motion understanding needs two conditions at once: the representation must couple off-screen camera motion with on-screen flow dynamics, and it must be interpreted by the language model rather than trained as a standalone pose or depth estimator. We propose CameraVLM, which pairs a motion-state representation with state-language alignment. Camera tokens capture how the camera moves off screen, flow tokens capture how the subject and background move on screen, and a two-stage training strategy keeps language in the loop so that both are learned together with camera-motion semantics. With only 9B parameters, CameraVLM outperforms all open-source and camera-motion-specific models by a wide margin across three benchmarks and more than 20 baselines, and matches or surpasses GPT-6 Astra as well as human viewers in a 48-participant study. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/CameraVLM/
items.summary: 本文提出CameraVLM，用运动状态表示结合状态—语言对齐，并通过两阶段训练将画外相机运动与画内光流动态耦合学习，在三个基准上声称以9B参数超过多种基线及GPT-6 Astra，并在48人研究中达到或超过人类观众。该工作对科研的用途在于为视觉语言模型的相机运动理解提供将表示学习与语言解释结合的研究方向，但其性能主张来自论文声明，且依赖特定基准与实验设置，尚需独立验证。

Beyond Policy Rollouts: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically uses small rollout groups per prompt, where repeated sampling from the same policy can yield highly similar trajectories, reducing within-group reward variation and weakening group-relative advantage signals. Existing remedies such as higher sampling temperature, entropy bonuses, asymmetric clipping, and larger rollout budgets broaden sampling or modify policy updates but leave rollout conditioning unchanged. In this paper, we propose EDEN (Embedding-space Directional Exploration via anchored Noise), which intervenes at the rollout source through anchored input perturbations. EDEN explores beyond the policy's own rollouts. Within the same rollout budget, it replaces a small fraction of standard rollouts in each group with rollouts that the same policy generates from the prompt plus a single appended, perturbed embedding position, rather than from the prompt alone. Gaussian noise drives variation, while a shared anchor provides a common conditioning direction within each prompt group. Selected perturbed rollouts contribute to GRPO updates with downweighted advantages, and the model architecture, discrete decoding, and test-time inference remain unchanged. Across model scales and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, EDEN outperforms GRPO and the exploration controls evaluated in the same pipeline, with the largest gains in sampled solution coverage. Analyses show that more prompt groups provide non-zero group-relative learning signals and that noise and anchoring play complementary roles. Intervening at the rollout source is thus an effective lever for exploration in RLVR.
items.summary: 本文提出EDEN，在RLVR的rollout源头通过锚定输入扰动进行嵌入空间方向探索，将每组中少量标准rollout替换为同一策略在提示后附加扰动嵌入位置生成的rollout，并以降权优势用于GRPO更新。该工作面向小rollout组下组内奖励变异不足的问题，作者报告其在数学推理基准和不同模型规模上优于GRPO及同流程探索基线，最大提升体现在采样解覆盖度，但摘要未给出具体性能数字，且所述优势来自论文自报结果而非独立验证。

items.title: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
items.excerpt: Web application development often proceeds through successive requests that extend an existing implementation. Yet web-generation benchmarks primarily evaluate development toward fixed specifications. We introduce EvoWeb, a novel benchmark comprising 320 cumulative requests over 32 web applications, grounded in real-world product features and structured by functional dependency graphs. Agents iteratively modify a persistent codebase, while a multimodal web agent tests each intermediate application in a live browser, assessing newly requested functionality, cross-request integration, and previously requested functionality. To characterize reliability throughout development, we integrate trajectory performance across user-tolerance thresholds rather than impose a fixed stopping criterion. Experiments across open- and closed-source frontier models show that EvoWeb reveals clear performance differences between models, with cross-request integration emerging as a key challenge. Further analysis shows that later requests with deeper or more numerous dependencies are solved less accurately, while runtime errors become more frequent over successive requests. EvoWeb provides a testbed for evaluating and improving coding agents in long-horizon, multi-request development.
items.summary: 本文提出了EvoWeb基准，包含32个Web应用上的320个累积请求，并基于功能依赖图组织，让智能体在持续存在的代码库上迭代修改，同时用多模态Web智能体在实时浏览器中测试每个中间应用，以评估新请求功能、跨请求集成和此前请求的功能。该基准可用于考察和比较编码智能体在多请求、长周期开发中的表现；原文实验显示不同模型存在明显性能差异，跨请求集成是主要挑战，且依赖更深或更多的后续请求解决准确率更低、运行时错误随请求推进更频繁，但这些结论仍限于其评测设置。

items.title: Relational Learning as World Modeling
items.excerpt: Relational learning typically predicts from a database state, but decision making asks a different question: how will that state change under an action? In operational systems, the answer depends on system-specific dynamics that may not be visible in the database itself. We view each such system as a relational "world" and ask whether a model can infer how it behaves from observed executions. We introduce TabWM (Tabular World Model) and WorldRel, a generator of executable relational worlds for pretraining. Given executions from an unseen world, TabWM uses them as context to predict the sparse structured edits caused by a new action without parameter updates. Across 512 held-out worlds, complete-edit F1 rises from 0.016 with no observed executions to 0.685 with 64, where a correct edit must match its operation, relational location, and value. Because these predictions are explicit relational edits, they can be applied recursively to imagine candidate futures and compare actions before they are taken. Broader search over these predicted futures improves the realized return of selected action sequences. Together, these results suggest that relational dynamics can be learned in context, broadening relational learning from modeling system state to modeling how that state changes under action.
items.summary: 本文提出TabWM（表格世界模型）及可执行关系世界生成器WorldRel，在未见世界的执行记录作为上下文条件下，无需参数更新即可预测新动作引发的稀疏结构化编辑，并在512个留出世界上报告完整编辑F1从无观测执行时的0.016升至64次观测时的0.685。该工作面向从建模系统状态扩展到建模状态在动作下如何变化的研究问题，所预测的显式关系编辑可递归用于想象候选未来并比较动作，对预测未来的更广泛搜索可提升所选动作序列的实际回报，但相关评估为论文报告的留出世界结果，不代表已在实际操作系统中验证，且其效果依赖观测执行所提供的系统特定动态信息。

items.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
items.excerpt: In recent months, we’ve made substantial progress on reducing the effectiveness of distillation attacks on Claude using new methods, as we outline in this blog. Early evidence suggests that these methods have reduced the amount of data harvested by distillers by around 90 to 99%. Distillation attacks are covert, industrial-scale campaigns to extract the capabilities of one model and replicate them in another, without the authorization of the original model’s developers. They are often conducted using networks of fraudulent accounts. These attacks allow companies to mimic frontier capabilities for a fraction of the development time and cost. As we wrote in September, this method has been used extensively to help overseas AI laboratories keep pace with US companies. We’re concerned about illicit distillation for two reasons. First, distillation enables companies to build models that approach the capability frontier, but which have, in practice, been released without proportionally robust safeguards. This means that distilled models could be used to cause significant harm in areas like biology and cybersecurity. Zhipu, for example, distilled the cyber capabilities of leading US models during the development of GLM-5.3. The company tried to distill Claude Fable 5—although, after finding that our cyber safeguards degraded its attacks, it switched to an older Claude model and another lab’s model. The US Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (CAISSI) has since assessed GLM-5.3 to be the most cyber-capable open-weights model released to date. Our own research has found that GLM-5.3’s safeguards can easily be bypassed, and that the model is willing to develop security exploits from end-to-end. Second, illicitly distilled models present a national security risk. The companies that distill US models are integrating the capabilities they gain from distillation into foreign military, intelligence, and surveillance systems. For example, we recently reported on a case in which requests to Moonshot’s Kimi models were secretly forwarded to Claude as part of its distillation efforts. items.title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
items.excerpt: Agent environments are essential for large language model (LLM) development. They use programmatic verifiers to turn complex outcomes into rewards. Verifiers can be attacked into awarding full credit to cheating agents without completing the intended task, causing inaccurate evaluation and misalignment in training. As agent environments scale in numbers and difficulty, so must the repairing of exploitable verifiers. To this end, we ask whether today's model with scaled compute can automatically harden agent environments to prevent potentially stronger future models from reward hacking. We introduce a scalable, fully automatic approach to weak-to-strong verifier hardening. It first sets up an isolated verifier sandbox that agents cannot directly modify, then uses a hacker-fixer loop to find and repair remaining verifier vulnerabilities. We apply this loop to Terminal Bench, KernelBench, and SETA, substantially reducing attack success across these agent environments. The iterative design scales with the hardening budget, producing progressively stronger defenses as the number of loop iterations increases and outperforming the static, non-iterative baseline. An earlier version of our hacker-fixer loop has been adopted by the official Terminal Bench repository as a way to audit exploits in its environments. Project page: https://verifier-hardening.github.io/.
items.summary: 本文提出一种可扩展的全自动弱到强验证器加固方法，先建立代理无法直接修改的隔离验证器沙箱，再用黑客-修复循环查找并修复验证器漏洞，并在Terminal Bench、KernelBench和SETA上进行了应用。该方法可用于自动审计和修复代理环境中的可被利用验证器，但其效果受加固预算影响并随循环迭代增加而逐步增强；文中报告的攻击成功率下降及优于静态基线等结果来自作者在特定环境上的实验，尚非独立验证的通用结论。

items.title: CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning
items.excerpt: Materials synthesis planning (MSP) connects AI-driven materials discovery to experimental realization by proposing precursors, synthesis operations, and processing conditions for a target material. Existing approaches predict these components separately or in pairs and treat conditions only as a prediction target. Consequently, MSP remains centered on recipe prediction: it leaves unexplored how conditions can serve as process context for constructing synthesis routes, and it does not address which candidate routes should be executed under limited experimental resources. We propose CondMSP, which extends MSP from recipe prediction to execution-aware planning. CondMSP predicts temperature, time, and atmosphere by combining a joint predictor with variable-specific experts, and then uses these predictions both as process context, grounding the generation and retrieval of operation sequences, and as execution requirements, specifying which thermal stages can share a furnace run and at what cost. This specification is held fixed across all compared methods; within it, CondMSP ranks routes across precursor sets by a common utility and, under furnace budgets, jointly selects routes and allocates their thermal stages by constrained optimization. CondMSP improves condition and operation prediction and, under this shared constraint, raises reference-recipe recovery from 27.9% to 32.9% at three simulated furnace runs per target and from 34.7% to 40.0% at 30 trials, while a new evaluation set of 2,344 targets supports generalization beyond oxide-dominated training chemistry.
items.summary: CondMSP 将无机材料合成规划从“配方预测”扩展为“执行感知规划”，通过预测温度、时间与气氛并同时将其用作构建操作序列的过程上下文和有限炉次资源下的执行约束，在约束优化中联合选择前驱体路线并分配热阶段，从而显著提升参考配方恢复率与泛化能力。

items.title: Tersoff-NN: Hybrid Machine-Learned Bond-Order Extension of the Tersoff Potential
items.excerpt: Accurate, robust, and efficient interatomic potentials are highly desirable for large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. Although machine-learning interatomic potentials can reproduce first-principles potential-energy surfaces with high accuracy, they typically incur higher computational costs than conventional empirical potentials and may be less reliable outside their training domains. We developed Tersoff-NN, a hybrid machine-learning potential for Si, which retains the analytical radial interactions and cutoff structure of the Tersoff potential while representing its environment-dependent bond-order factor using compact neural networks (NNs). Benchmarks for 32,768-atom systems show that Tersoff-NN is 4-12 times faster than the Behler-Parrinello-type NN potentials tested in this study. Tersoff-NN improves the short-range structure of liquid Si relative to the conventional Tersoff potential, closely reproduces the ab initio radial and angular distributions, and reproduces the equilibrium structure of diamond Si and qualitative energetic trends among several crystalline phases. Furthermore, melt-quench simulations reveal a disordered solid with predominantly four-coordinated, tetrahedral-like local environments. Additionally, characteristic reconstruction motifs are retained on Si surfaces despite their exclusion from the training dataset. A direct comparison with an alternative atom-centered bond-order NN highlights the critical role of physical constraints in ensuring dynamic stability. Despite exhibiting comparable validation errors, the selected triplet-based architecture remains stable, while an alternative model exhibits unphysical bond-order growth and atomic collapse. These results confirm that learning only the bond-order term improves the description of diverse Si environments while retaining substantial computational efficiency and enhancing dynamical stability.
items.summary: 本文提出Tersoff-NN，一种用于硅的混合机器学习势，它保留Tersoff势的解析径向相互作用和截断结构，并用紧凑神经网络表示其环境依赖的键序因子。该势在测试中比Behler-Parrinello型神经网络势快4至12倍，并改善液态硅短程结构；但摘要所述性能仅基于特定测试体系，未验证其在训练域外的可靠性。

items.title: World Modeling through Spectral Alignment
items.excerpt: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.
items.summary: 本文提出SpecWM，一个JEPA框架，通过目标相似核显式指定观测间关系，并训练编码器在嵌入几何中复现这些关系，同时刻画了目标的全局最优并给出线性可恢复性与干扰信息不变性的条件。对科研工作而言，该框架提供了一种通过显式指定表示几何来引导潜在世界模型保留控制所需信息的途径，但相关实证提升来自原研究在OGBench与CALVIN任务上的报告，尚非经独立验证的结论。

Balancing Temperature Stability and Dielectric Loss in Microwave Ceramics via Embedded Polar Nanoregions
items.excerpt: ABSTRACT The deployment of 5G/6G communication systems demands microwave dielectric ceramics that simultaneously possess a near-zero temperature coefficient of resonant frequency and an ultra-low dielectric loss (tan δ ), which represents a long-standing challenge that demands effective optimization strategies. Herein, the fundamental limitation is substantially alleviated by a strategy integrating interpretable machine learning with entropy engineering, enabling the reverse design of a medium-entropy perovskite microwave ceramic composition (Ca 0.7 Sm 0.27 Nd 0.03 )[Ti 0.686 (Mg 1/3 Nb 2/3 ) 0.014 Al 0.3 ]O 3 . This ceramic material delivers a desired combination perfomance of τ f = −0.18 ppm/°C and tan δ = 1.19 × 10 −4 at 4.6 GHz. Multiscale characterization reveals that entropy-induced chemical disorder creates isolated polar nanoregions that pin charged defects, transforming them from a source of relaxation loss into static structural units, which is different from the conventional defect-loss correlation mechanism. The optimized ceramic is implemented in a dielectric resonator antenna, which demonstrates superior performance: a radiation efficiency of 96.2% and a gain of 6.06 dBi. The findings establish a generalizable framework for navigating complex compositional spaces and resolving conflicting properties in perovskite materials.

History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
items.excerpt: Linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling, yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. This coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability. We challenge this presumed ceiling: recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage. We introduce NoteBank, a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known, uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. This training-free, plug-and-play interface requires no external embedding model, separately trained retriever, or separate neural reader. At one million tokens, it raises Gated DeltaNet's mean accuracy across six RULER retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3%, with no observed significant retrieval degradation from 4K to 1M tokens. This recovery adds leqslant0.025% to analytical FLOPs, with persistent context storage approximately 1/2,600 that of a Transformer's full MHA KV cache at matched width, depth, and precision. Experiments extend from three 1.3B recurrent backbones to Mamba-2-8B and post-trained Qwen3.5-9B, demonstrating gains on LongBench v1/v2 and MemoryAgentBench. Together, these results show that sparse evidence storage and native replay can substantially expand the long-context capability of pretrained linear attention models while retaining the efficiency of recurrent computation.
items.summary: 本文提出NoteBank，一种无需训练、即插即用的稀疏情景记忆接口，在查询发生前归档选定文本，并利用主干模型的原生特征进行写入、寻址与重放读取；据原文报告，在100万token时它将Gated DeltaNet在六项RULER检索任务上的平均准确率从1.7%提升至70.3%，且4K至1M token范围内未观察到显著检索退化。上述性能数字来自作者实验报告，未经独立验证；该接口对预训练线性注意力模型长上下文能力的实际提升幅度与适用范围，仍取决于具体任务、模型和实现条件。

items.title: Pressure-transferable universal machine-learning potentials: the WBM-MatPES benchmark and Tuga-FF
items.excerpt: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials hold the promise to replace costly ab initio calculations in materials science workflows. However, the accuracy and transferability of current models are limited by the availability of training data. We release WBM-MatPES, a dataset of 182 thousand structures recomputed with consistent MatPES settings, together with two reference convex hulls of different depths and test sets at six pressures up to 150 GPa. These datasets reproduce a realistic discovery workflow and allow potentials to be ranked systematically at this level of theory, similar to the Matbench Discovery leaderboard at the Materials Project settings. In this benchmark, five published MatPES potentials agree within 12 meV/atom at 25 GPa, yet their errors increase dramatically to 0.4-5 eV/atom at 150 GPa. To address this limitation, we develop Tuga-FF, a graph transformer trained on datasets spanning ambient and high-pressure configurations alike. Tuga-FF is the most accurate model in the benchmark at ambient pressure, with an energy error of 13.6 meV/atom, and maintains an error of just 21 meV/atom at 150 GPa. We believe this benchmark will encourage the community to train higher-accuracy models and generate richer datasets, advancing machine-learned interatomic potentials as a whole.

items.title: Triage-PiEvo: Evidence Admission for Principle-Evolving Scientific Agents
items.excerpt: Large language model (LLM)-based AI Scientists advance scientific discovery, yet they suffer from inefficiencies due to noisy observations. Existing principle-evolving agents act on every anomaly, leaving its source unresolved: a new mechanism or an evaluation artifact, so invalid revisions bias evolution. To address this, we formulate revision as evidence admission: anomalies steer search immediately, but only independently verified evidence may rewrite persistent principles, and contradicted principles are retracted. We realize this in TRIAGE-PIEVO , which pairs an anomaly-responsive search portfolio with a staged verification gate that alone controls what enters principle state. Across four scientific tasks with three backbones, TRIAGE-PIEVO (1) attains the highest average solution quality with +7.5%~11.8% over the strongest baseline per backbone, matching the strongest baseline's full-budget quality with one-third of the evaluation budget on Qwen3-235B; and additional stress tests and cross-harness deployment demonstrate that (2) in constructed stress tests, it admits none of the corrupted, hidden-source, or exploit evidence that ungated variants admit, while missing no planted mechanism, and (3) plugged unchanged into three external research harnesses, it cuts false evidence admissions by over 60% and raises verified scores by 31%~43%.
items.summary: 本文提出TRIAGE-PIEVO，将原则演化智能体中的修订过程表述为证据准入：异常可立即引导搜索，但只有经独立验证的证据才能改写持久原则，被矛盾的原则则被撤回。对于科研工作，其用途是减少因噪声观测引发的无效原则修订，且该框架可原样接入外部研究流程以降低虚假证据准入并提高已验证得分；但相关性能提升与削减效果均来自论文自身报告，尚需独立验证，且所述结果不涵盖全部可能场景。

items.title: Scaling Laws for Multimodal Data Mixtures
items.excerpt: Frontier AI systems are increasingly natively multimodal, jointly pretrained on multiple modalities, such as text, vision, and audio. However, the scientific understanding of the multimodal data mixtures used to pretrain these systems --- how much of each modality to mix, and at what potential interference cost to the others --- is largely absent or gatekept. In this work, we derive data mixing scaling laws for three modalities: text, vision, and audio. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly adopt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, as MoEs scale efficiently and partially limit cross-modal interference. We therefore use MoEs to conduct 268 experiments ranging from 457M to 8.3B parameters, on up to 150 billion tokens. Our work leads to multiple actionable insights into multimodal data mixing for training MLLMs. First, compute optima are modality-specific: audio modality is model-heavy, favoring scaling parameters over tokens, while text and vision require balanced scaling of model size and data. Second, repeating vision or audio data beyond 2x yields negligible benefits. Finally, cross-modal interactions are highly asymmetric: vision strongly interferes with audio, whereas audio's interference with learning text and vision is negligible. Overall, we provide a principled foundation for understanding the multimodal data mixtures needed to train frontier MLLMs.
items.summary: 本文基于Mixture-of-Experts架构开展268组实验（参数规模457M至8.3B、训练数据至多1500亿token），推导了文本、视觉和音频三种模态的数据混合缩放规律。这些规律可用于指导多模态大语言模型预训练中不同模态数据配比与计算资源分配，但其结论限于所考察的模态、模型规模和数据量范围。

items.title: Do LLMs Read for Free? Auditing the Open Access Bias in AI-Mediated Science
items.excerpt: How large language models affect various social activities has been widely discussed; however, how large language models themselves influence the mechanisms of scientific knowledge production remains unclear. To investigate this question, this paper designs a quasi-experimental study based on a large-scale bibliometric dataset. Using a Difference-in-Differences model and analyzing citation records from 64,841 articles across 120 communication journals, we find that the emergence of large language models is associated with a widening of the visibility gap between Open Access (OA) and non-OA articles. Specifically, OA articles experienced a significant post-ChatGPT citation acceleration of approximately 0.84% per month, accumulating to roughly 10% over 12 months. Importantly, this estimate represents a conservative lower bound, as gradual LLM adoption and journal review lags attenuate the measured treatment intensity. The findings are consistent with the view that, while LLMs may promote knowledge dissemination, they also risk exacerbating inequality in academic knowledge production—though the precise mechanism behind this pattern remains an important direction for future research.

Large-scale identical-location electron microscopy enables quantifying nanoparticulate electrocatalyst degradation
items.excerpt: Abstract Fuel cells convert chemical energy into electricity, and their performance relies on electrocatalysts whose durability during operation remains poorly understood. Deep mechanistic insight into electrocatalyst stability is essential to design durable, resource-efficient fuel cells. Nanoparticulate electrocatalysts degrade via diverse nanoscale processes, yet particle-to-particle heterogeneity in structure, support interaction, and local microenvironment make true particle-level quantification and understanding impossible with classical approaches. Here we scale up identical-location scanning transmission electron microscopy, which repeatedly images the very same nanoparticles, to track the structural evolution of hundreds of carbon-supported platinum-cobalt nanoparticles, a prototypical oxygen reduction reaction electrocatalyst. We present a three-step image analysis workflow comprising segmentation, tracking, and degradation-event classification with progressive automation, including machine-learning-assisted detection of overlapping particles. By pairing nanoscale resolution and local history with population-level statistics, the pipeline enables unbiased identification and quantification of degradation pathways across statistically meaningful particle sets. We reveal particle size- and shape-dependent effects, showing that smaller and irregular nanoparticles are more prone to detachment, and provide a data-driven framework for probing electrocatalyst degradation at scale.

items.excerpt: Artificial intelligence (AI) has become a general-purpose set of computational methods that is increasingly embedded in scientific research and technological systems. This critical narrative review evaluates the principal roles of AI across scientific discovery, medicine, environmental and space science, manufacturing, software engineering, cybersecurity and communication networks, while distinguishing demonstrated capabilities from claims that remain context dependent. The review also examines conceptual differences between task-bounded AI and human intelligence, and considers human–AI collaboration as a practical design problem rather than a contest between interchangeable forms of intelligence. Literature was selected through transparent live scholarly searching and verification, with an emphasis on peer-reviewed evidence, primary studies for prominent performance claims and authoritative governance sources. The evidence indicates that AI is especially useful where large, high-dimensional or multimodal data must be classified, modelled or searched, and where repeated decisions can be evaluated against explicit performance criteria. Examples include protein-structure prediction, anomaly detection, remote-sensing analysis, autonomous planetary navigation, smart manufacturing and cyber-threat analysis. Nevertheless, high benchmark performance does not automatically establish clinical utility, causal understanding, robustness under distribution shift, safety or equitable deployment. Major cross-cutting limitations include data quality, representativeness, opaque decision processes, evaluation leakage, infrastructure requirements, environmental cost, cybersecurity vulnerabilities and uneven institutional capacity. Responsible integration therefore requires task-specific validation, human oversight, traceability, monitoring and governance proportional to potential harm. Future progress will depend less on simply increasing model scale than on improving scientific validity, causal and mechanistic integration, reproducibility, context-sensitive evaluation and access in lower-resource settings. items.title: ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer
items.excerpt: Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. We further introduce \muE, an extension of maximal update parameterization (\mup) to \Ours and other elastic architectures. Its scaling rules provably keep all sub-networks of a supernet maximally updated simultaneously (\muI), and keep doing so when the supernet is widened or given more shells; sweeps confirm that HPs tuned on a small non-elastic proxy stay near-optimal for elastic families and larger supernets (\muT). A single \Ours run produces sub-networks that outperform MatFormer and fully elastic baselines at matched parameter counts, and approach separately trained models that together take several times the steps.
items.summary: 本文提出ShellElastic，一种将隐藏维度组织为密集核心与连续外壳、使每个隐藏矩阵呈块下三角结构的弹性Transformer，并引入将最大更新参数化（μP）扩展至该类架构的μE，使一次全宽前向即可联合训练所有嵌套子网络。据摘要，其可用于让单一训练运行产出适配不同推理预算的子网络，并在匹配参数量下优于MatFormer及全弹性基线；但原文同时指出既有弹性训练方案面临分布式扩展、超参数跨模型规模迁移及子网络同时最大更新无保证等限制，且摘要中的性能比较未说明是否经独立复现验证。

items.title: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
items.excerpt: Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seven state-of-the-art deep-research harnesses, all using a shared language-model backbone and frozen corpora. PANINI-DR achieves the strongest average performance across the three benchmarks. On BrowseComp-Plus, it achieves 73.3% accuracy, outperforming the next-best harness by 16.0 points. Its advantage is strongest on hard questions, where it answers nearly twice as many as the next-best harness. Ablations further show that structured planning and persistent state improve performance, as does checking each finding against its cited evidence before it is reused. Because a model can answer correctly from memory alone, we also analyze the evidence retained by each harness. PANINI-DR achieves the highest answer recoverability from saved evidence on all three benchmarks, while complementary claim-support audits show stronger evidence-backed answers. Accounting for this evidence changes how harnesses compare and further strengthens PANINI-DR's advantage.
items.summary: PANINI-DR是一个多智能体研究框架，将整体调查的协调与各子问题的研究和验证分离，并用基于生成语义工作区表示的共享工作区记录子问题、依赖关系、发现和支持证据。该框架在BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES和MoNaCo三个基准上使用共享语言模型骨干和冻结语料进行评测，据原文报告取得最强平均表现，在BrowseComp-Plus上达到73.3%准确率、比次优框架高16.0个百分点，消融显示结构化规划和持久状态以及在使用发现前对照引用证据进行核查均有帮助；但上述性能与优势均为论文报告结果而非独立验证，且摘要未说明其在不同模型骨干、开放语料或真实科研流程中的适用边界，使用时应视为待复现和待外部确认的声明。

items.title: Who to Trust in Multi-Robot Systems: Joint Robot and Object Hypothesis Trust Inference via Neural-Symbolic Cross-Validation
items.excerpt: Multi-robot systems (MRS) offer significant advantages over single-robot platforms by enabling information sharing and coordination for different tasks in complex environments. However, reliable cooperation critically depends on inferring trust over both information sources and their reported hypotheses, particularly under partial observability and potential adversarial interference. Existing approaches frequently depend on pre-established trust relationships or side-channel information, which may not be available or reliable in realistic MRS deployments. This work introduces NeST-Bayes, a neural-symbolic framework that jointly infers robot and hypothesis trust using only inter-robot observation consistency, without requiring preassigned robot trust, reputation information, or side-channel identity signals. NeST-Bayes infers instantaneous trust evidence scores for robots and object hypotheses by reasoning over ego-centric relational graphs constructed from cross-robot observation consistency. These evidence scores are accumulated over time through Bayesian updates of Beta-distributed trust beliefs to maintain temporally consistent trust estimates. Extensive evaluations show that NeST-Bayes achieves the highest mean object precision and robot recall across all benchmark settings, and the highest robot precision and object recall in most settings, compared to trust-based methods. Under aggressive optimized attacks, it achieves 98.8\% robot precision with 93.8\% recall and 98.3\% object precision with 95.4\% recall. In an occlusion-rich Webots warehouse, it maintains 92.5\% robot precision with 92.0\% recall and 97.3\% object precision with 85.0\% recall. These results demonstrate joint improvements in the reliability and coverage of retained information.
items.summary: 本文提出NeST-Bayes神经符号框架，仅依据机器人间观测一致性联合推断机器人信任与对象假设信任，无需预设机器人信任、声誉信息或侧信道身份信号，并通过基于Beta分布信任信念的贝叶斯更新累积瞬时信任证据。该框架可用于多机器人系统在部分可观测和潜在对抗干扰下筛选可信信息源与假设；原文报告在优化攻击和遮挡丰富环境中的精度与召回率结果，但摘要未说明其是否适用于其他攻击类型或真实部署场景。

items.title: Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments
items.excerpt: Words are increasingly becoming an interface for action: large language models (LLMs) can now invoke tools, operate devices, and make decisions that affect the physical world. However, current benchmarks largely evaluate LLMs through static text responses, offline tool calls, or simulated tasks, leaving open the question of how well they can act in real physical environments. We present a benchmark for measuring LLMs in closed-loop physical interaction, where models control a harness system connected to real-world components including robotic arms, cameras, and sensors. In each task, the model must issue instructions, receive physical feedback from the environment, interpret the resulting state, and adapt its next action accordingly. This setting evaluates capabilities beyond language understanding, including grounded perception, action planning, tool selection, spatial reasoning, feedback-driven correction, and robustness to execution uncertainty. Through experiments with representative LLMs, we characterize their ability to translate linguistic reasoning into physical actions and identify common failure modes such as hallucinated state changes, poor recovery from unexpected outcomes, and unstable long-horizon plans. Our benchmark aims to provide a systematic foundation for evaluating LLMs as interactive agents that connect words, tools, and the physical world.
items.summary: 本文提出了一个在闭环物理交互中评测大语言模型的基准，模型通过连接机械臂、摄像头和传感器等真实组件的执行系统完成任务，需发出指令、接收物理反馈并据此调整后续动作。该基准可用于考察语言推理向物理动作转化的能力，并识别幻觉状态变化、异常结果恢复不佳和长时程规划不稳定等失败模式，但摘要未给出具体性能数字或验证结论。

items.title: Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving
items.excerpt: High-fidelity closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving increasingly relies on dense multi-view 3D reconstruction. While recent feed-forward geometric foundation models have revolutionized per-scene optimization, applying them to continuous, long-horizon driving sequences is computationally intractable due to GPU memory limits and the quadratic complexity of global attention. Existing scaling strategies are fundamentally limited, as causal streaming suffers from compounding scale drift and trajectory deviation, while rigid "chunk-then-align" heuristics fragment global context and produce trajectory discontinuities. To address these limitations, we introduce Drive3R, a block-wise streaming geometric foundation model. Its block-wise causal attention resolves the scalability bottleneck of fully bidirectional attention while avoiding the loss of local future context in purely causal streaming. Its confidence-aware re-anchoring further mitigates long-range drift by detecting unreliable streaming states, re-initializing the KV cache, and stitching refreshed segments through SE(3) alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Drive3R establishes a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Specifically, on nuScenes, it improves over the recent DVGT-2 baseline from 0.1806 to 0.1081 in AbsRel, from 0.6750 to 0.5344 in point-cloud Accuracy, and from 1.5812 to 0.9092 in ATE.
items.summary: 本文提出Drive3R，一种块级流式几何基础模型，采用块级因果注意力以缓解全双向注意力的可扩展性瓶颈，并通过置信度感知重锚定检测不可靠流式状态、重初始化KV缓存及经SE(3)对齐拼接刷新片段，以减轻长程漂移。据原文报告，该模型在nuScenes、KITTI和Waymo上取得新的最优结果，在nuScenes上相对DVGT-2基线改善了AbsRel、点云Accuracy和ATE；但这些为公司或作者声明，尚未经独立验证，且原文未说明其是否适用于超出上述数据集的场景或是否完全消除长序列漂移。

Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
items.excerpt: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.

items.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
items.excerpt: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
items.summary: 本文提出Chronos Policy，将观测采集时间和动作执行时间显式编码为策略输入，并采用时间感知旋转位置编码（time-aware RoPE）替代基于序列位置的位置编码，同时通过对训练中观测采样和动作块起点的时序随机化，使策略能从异步、多速率数据中学习而无需对齐到固定时间网格。该工作面向动态任务、多传感器任务和准静态任务，声称可提升对传感与推理时序变化的鲁棒性；但这些性能结论来自原文报告，属于公开材料中的声明，未在本摘要中独立验证。

items.title: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language
items.excerpt: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14\% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57\% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.

items.title: Necessary conditions for benchmarking next-generation AI in materials discovery
items.excerpt: Current AI predicts materials by speeding up energy minimisation and training on large databases. However, scaling data generation prevents manual analysis by domain experts. If novelty is evaluated by chemical compositions or traditional representations in Crystallographic Information Files, or standard structure matchers based on manually chosen thresholds, one can easily generate millions of ``new'' compositions or files without discovering truly novel materials. This paper uses a hierarchy of crystal invariants to continuously trace and quantify structural novelty based on the new mathematical definition of a crystal structure and asymptotic guarantees for invariant descriptors. The invariant-based analysis through cascade computations on a modest computer exposes the unexpected scale of duplication in the world's largest materials databases, shown here in the high-profile case of GNoME datasets. To prevent current ``embarrassment of over-prediction'', we propose necessary conditions for next-generation AI that should be automatically enforced before claiming any new materials.

items.title: Doubly Metastable Synthesis for Accelerated Quantum Materials Discovery
items.excerpt: New physics emerges from new materials, which in turn rely on the development of new synthesis techniques. Identifying the enlargement of metastable synthesis window as enabling for realizing novel materials, we develop diffusion-activated epitaxy, a technique which combines two metastable synthesis methods of diffusion and epitaxy. We observe that within a narrow window of investigated synthesis space we can experimentally identify the stabilization of four distinct phases, three of which show X-ray diffraction and scanning transmission electron microscopy characterization data that are incompatible with the crystal structures registered in experimental and computational inorganic structure databases. These results suggest an enlarged metastable synthesis window is enabled by this synthesis approach, identifying doubly metastable synthesis as a promising method for exploration of quantum materials.

items.title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
items.excerpt: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.
items.summary: ReplaySSM 将 SSM 状态表示为检查点加近期输入缓冲区，从而在多数解码步骤避免完整状态写入、以缓冲区指针实现投机回滚，并允许输出计算与循环更新使用不同精度的检查点。该设计在 vLLM 中面向 Mamba-2 和 Gated DeltaNet 实现，摘要报告其在服务批次 256 下相对调优基线加速标准解码，并提升投机解码吞吐、降低输出 KL 散度与下游精度损失；但这些性能与精度结果来自公开摘要所述，尚未经独立验证。

items.title: Sonic-AMG: Streaming Human Motion Generation from Spatial Audio
items.excerpt: Modeling human reactions to spatial audio requires understanding both what is heard and where it comes from. Prior work generates motion offline from complete acoustic and spatial input sequences. Humans, however, react to sounds without knowing what they will hear next. We present Sonic-AMG, to our knowledge the first framework for streaming human motion generation from spatial audio. The model encodes acoustic content and body-relative source geometry as separate tokens. Conditioned on these tokens, a causal transformer with a flow head generates continuous motion latents, from which a causal decoder reconstructs motion segments. Standard teacher-forced training derives motion histories and body-relative source locations from ground-truth motion, whereas streaming inference relies on generated motion for both, resulting in a training-inference mismatch. To reduce this history discrepancy, we introduce rehearsal training, which combines full-sequence teacher-forced supervision with supervised prediction along short autoregressive self-rollouts. To keep spatial conditioning consistent with generated motion, we propose spatial feedback, which recomputes body-relative source locations from generated root poses during both rehearsal training and inference. On SAM, Sonic-AMG achieves state-of-the-art FID and R-precision. It further supports real-time online generation of coherent reactions across sound events and source locations. Project page: https://jingchengni.com/sonic-amg/.
items.summary: Sonic-AMG被提出为一个从空间音频进行流式人体动作生成的框架，它将声学内容与身体相对声源几何编码为分离的 what 和 where token，并引入 rehearsal training 以减少训练与推理间的运动历史不匹配、引入 spatial feedback 以在训练和推理中从生成的动作重算身体相对声源位置。原文报告该框架在 SAM 数据集上取得 FID 和 R-precision 的最新结果，并支持跨声音事件与声源位置的实时在线连贯反应生成，但这些性能声明来自作者在所提供的公开摘要与正文节选中的表述，未在本文档中独立验证；该证据材料同时被标注为有限摘录，不代表已阅读或核验完整论文。

items.title: Quantitative modeling of acid-base equilibria
items.excerpt: Simulating acid-base equilibria from first principles is a tremendous challenge, as it requires modeling bond-breaking events in a complex hydrogen-bonding environment. The quantum mechanical behavior of the protons is often important, complicating simulations even further. We show that by combining state-of-the-art machine-learning potentials, accelerated sampling of the dissociation process, and an efficient estimation of nuclear quantum corrections it is possible to reliably compute the dissociation constants of different species in water. We demonstrate the transferability of this workflow, applying it successfully to the autoionization of water and to the entire ladder of the aqueous dissociation of phosphoric acid. The definition of the dissociation constant, the choice of order parameters, sampling artifacts and finite-size effects, as well as quantum nuclear effects all play a non-trivial role in determining the outcome of the calculation, so that cutting corners is likely to introduce biases that can only be compensated by fortuitous cancellations of errors.
items.summary: 本文结合先进的机器学习势、加速解离过程采样以及核量子修正的高效估计，提出了一个可从第一性原理可靠计算水中不同物种解离常数的工作流程，并成功将其应用于水的自电离和磷酸在水中的全部逐级解离。该工作表明解离常数的定义、序参量选择、采样伪影、有限尺寸效应和量子核效应都会对计算结果产生重要影响，因此在实际科研中简化处理可能引入偏差，只有在偶然误差抵消时才可能被补偿。
